items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Mia has lived in Busan since she was seven.
We have known each other for ten years.
I have never tasted such a spicy soup.
My uncle has gone to Japan last month.
They have been waiting for the bus for thirty minutes.
items.exp: last month처럼 과거를 나타내는 부사구는 현재완료와 함께 쓸 수 없어요. 단순과거 went로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
choices: When have you met your English teacher?
Have you finished your homework yet?
How long have you been learning the violin?
She hasn't called me since Monday.
I have lost my key, so I can't open the door.
items.exp: when처럼 과거의 때를 묻는 의문사는 현재완료와 함께 쓸 수 없어요. When did you meet ~?로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He has been knowing her since 2018.
She has been baking cookies since this morning.
Sam has gone to Paris twice.
The bakery has been open since two years.
items.exp: since + 과거 시점과 현재완료진행이 알맞아요. 나머지는 상태동사의 진행형, yesterday와 현재완료, 경험을 뜻하는 has gone, since + 기간이 틀려요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장을 고르세요.
choices: We have gone to Jeju three times.
We have been to Jeju three times ago.
We have been to Jeju for three times.
We have visit Jeju three times.
We have been to Jeju three times.
items.exp: 경험은 have been to로 나타내요. have gone to는 '가고 없다'는 뜻이고, ago와 현재완료는 함께 쓸 수 없으며, 현재완료는 have + 과거분사(visited)여야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) It has been raining since last night.
(b) I have visited Rome last summer.
(c) My brother has lost his key, so he can't open the door.
(d) He has been sick for three days.
(e) My parents have married for twenty years.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: since + 과거 시점과 현재완료진행이 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: last summer는 과거 표현이므로 visited로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 결과 용법의 현재완료로 알맞아요. (d) 옳음: for + 기간과 현재완료로 알맞아요. (e) 틀림: '결혼한 상태가 계속'은 have been married로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Have you ever ridden a horse?
(b) Tom has been to Spain, so he is in Madrid now.
(c) How long has she been studying Chinese?
(d) The boys have played soccer since two hours.
(e) I haven't heard from him for a week.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 경험의 현재완료로 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: 지금 그곳에 있다면 has gone to가 되어야 해요. has been to는 갔다 왔다는 뜻이에요. (c) 옳음: how long과 현재완료진행이 알맞아요. (d) 틀림: since 뒤에는 시점이 와야 하므로 for two hours로 고쳐야 해요. (e) 옳음: for + 기간과 현재완료로 알맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) We have just arrived at the station.
(b) He has been working here since he graduated.
(c) They have been knowing each other for years.
(d) I have never seen such a big whale.
(e) She has been cleaning her room for an hour.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 완료 용법으로 알맞아요. (b) 옳음: since 뒤 과거 시제 절과 현재완료진행으로 알맞아요. (c) 틀림: know는 상태동사라 진행형을 쓰지 않아요. have known으로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: 경험 용법으로 알맞아요. (e) 옳음: for + 기간과 현재완료진행으로 알맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I have known Jim since I was a child.
(b) I have known Jim when I was a child.
(c) The movie has started just now.
(d) The movie has just started.
(e) We have lived here for five years.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: since 뒤 과거 절과 현재완료로 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: 접속사 when 뒤 과거 시점은 현재완료와 어울리지 않고 since를 써야 해요. (c) 틀림: just now는 과거 표현이라 started로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: just는 현재완료와 함께 쓸 수 있어요. (e) 옳음: for + 기간과 현재완료로 알맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Has he ever been to Canada?
(b) She has worked here since five years.
(c) I have read the novel three times.
(d) My sister has bought the shoes yesterday.
(e) It has snowed for two days.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 경험의 현재완료 의문문으로 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: since 뒤에는 시점이 와야 하므로 for five years로 고쳐야 해요. (c) 옳음: 경험 용법으로 알맞아요. (d) 틀림: yesterday와 현재완료는 함께 쓸 수 없고 bought여야 해요. (e) 옳음: for + 기간과 현재완료로 알맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The volcano is erupting for a week.
(b) The volcano has been erupting for a week.
(c) We have gone to the zoo before.
(d) Jane has gone to the airport, so she isn't at home.
(e) Have you been waiting long?
items.exp: (a) 틀림: for + 기간과 함께 쓰려면 has been erupting이어야 해요. (b) 옳음: 현재완료진행으로 알맞아요. (c) 틀림: 경험을 말할 때는 have been to를 써요. (d) 옳음: has gone to는 '가고 없다'는 결과를 나타내요. (e) 옳음: 현재완료진행 의문문으로 알맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Tim (A) ___ in Seoul since 2020, and he (B) ___ to Busan twice.
items.exp: (A)는 since 2020과 함께 계속을 나타내는 현재완료 has lived, (B)는 twice가 있는 경험이므로 has been to가 알맞아요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Mina (A) ___ her wallet last night, and she still (B) ___ it.
items.exp: (A)는 last night이라는 과거 표현이 있으므로 lost, (B)는 still과 함께 현재까지 못 찾았다는 뜻의 현재완료 부정 hasn't found가 알맞아요.

items.q:
다음 밑줄 친 부분과 현재완료의 용법이 같은 것은?
<보기> I [have visited] the museum twice.
choices: I [have been] in this town for ten years.
items.exp: <보기>는 twice가 있는 경험 용법이에요. 정답도 never가 있는 경험 용법이에요. 나머지는 완료, 계속, 결과, 완료 용법이에요.

items.q:
다음 밑줄 친 부분과 현재완료의 용법이 같은 것은?
<보기> He [has lived] in Daegu for six years.
choices: My brother [has been] sick since Monday.
I [have not finished] my report yet.
items.exp: <보기>는 for six years가 있는 계속 용법이에요. 정답도 since Monday가 있는 계속 용법이에요. 나머지는 경험, 완료, 결과, 완료 용법이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 어제부터 계속 두통이 있다.
items.s: I ___ since yesterday.
items.exp: 어제부터 현재까지 계속되는 상태이므로 현재완료(계속) have had를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 아이들은 두 시간 동안 연을 날리고 있는 중이다.
items.s: The children ___ kites for two hours.
items.exp: 과거부터 지금까지 계속 진행 중인 동작은 현재완료진행 have been + -ing로 나타내요.

items.q: 다음 두 문장을 현재완료를 이용하여 한 문장으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: He went to Rome, and he is still there.
items.s: He ___ Rome.
items.exp: 로마에 가서 지금 그곳에 있다는 결과이므로 has gone to를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Tina [has bought] this bag two weeks ago. → ___
items.exp: two weeks ago는 명백한 과거 표현이므로 현재완료와 쓸 수 없어요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My little sister [has been knowing] the answer since this morning. → ___
items.exp: know는 상태동사라 진행형을 쓰지 않고 현재완료 has known으로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 너는 이 도시에서 얼마나 오래 살았니?
items.s: How long ___ in this city?
items.exp: how long으로 현재까지의 기간을 물을 때는 현재완료(진행)를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The little boy cried because he had lost his toy robot at the park.
By the end of this month, they will have built the bridge.
My father had been repairing the roof for two hours when it began to snow.
She had been knowing the answer for a long time before anyone asked her.
I had never tasted Indian food before I went to the festival.
items.exp: know는 상태를 나타내는 동사라 진행형으로 쓰지 않아요. had been knowing → had known으로 고쳐야 해요. 나머지는 모두 과거완료·미래완료 쓰임이 알맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: By the time the guests arrive, we will have finished cooking.
By the time the guests will arrive, we will have finished cooking.
The movie had already started when we have found our seats.
She has been waiting for an hour when the bus finally came.
By 2030, scientists have discovered a cure for the disease.
items.exp: 시간의 부사절에서는 미래를 현재시제로 나타내서 arrive가 맞아요. 나머지는 will arrive → arrive, have found → found, has been waiting → had been waiting, have discovered → will have discovered로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: Jisu will have finished all her homework by the time you come home.
By the time I woke up, my brother had already eaten all the pancakes.
The workers had been painting the fence since morning, so their clothes were covered with paint.
Next month, my grandparents will have been married for fifty years.
The guide told us that the museum has been closed for two weeks before we visited it.
items.exp: we visited(과거)보다 먼저 닫혀 있던 상태이므로 has been closed가 아니라 had been closed여야 해요. 나머지 문장은 시제가 모두 알맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: By the time the movie ended, half of the audience will have left.
He didn't pass the exam because he had not studied enough.
When we arrived at the airport, the plane has already taken off.
She will have learned to swim before she will start middle school.
I have been living in this town for ten years when my brother was born.
items.exp: 시험에 떨어진 시점(과거)보다 공부를 덜 한 때가 먼저이므로 had not studied가 맞아요. 나머지는 will have left → had left, has already taken off → had already taken off, will start → starts, have been living → had been living으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The soup had gone cold because nobody had come to the table.
(b) By the time I found the key, my sister has already left for school.
(c) Ben had been fishing for hours when he finally caught a big trout.
(d) The company will have launched the new phone before next winter ends.
(e) When the bell rang, the students will have finished the test.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거 시점 이전의 일이라 과거완료가 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: has already left → had already left (found라는 과거 시점 이전). (c) 옳음. 과거완료진행으로 caught 이전부터 계속된 동작을 나타내요. (d) 옳음. 미래 시점 이전에 끝나는 일이라 미래완료가 맞아요. (e) 틀림: will have finished → had finished (과거 시점 기준). 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) After the storm had passed, the villagers came out of their houses.
(b) The singer had sung three songs before the power went out.
(c) Mr. Lee will have taught English for thirty years when he retires next year.
(d) My uncle had been owning a small shop until he sold it last year.
(e) They had lived in Daegu for five years before they will move to Seoul.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 폭풍이 지나간 것이 먼저라 had passed가 알맞아요. (b) 옳음. 정전 이전에 완료된 일이라 과거완료가 알맞아요. (c) 옳음. 시간 부사절은 현재시제 retires, 주절은 미래완료가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: own은 소유(상태) 동사라 진행형 불가. had been owning → had owned. (e) 틀림: before 절이 과거 시점이므로 will move → moved. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The rain had stopped by the time we left the cafe.
(b) She will have forgotten everything by the time she is eighty.
(c) My dog had been barking for ten minutes before I noticed the stranger.
(d) Nobody knew that the old man had once been a famous pilot.
(e) He has gone to bed early last night because he was tired.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. left보다 먼저 그쳤으므로 과거완료가 맞아요. (b) 옳음. 시간 부사절은 현재시제 is, 주절은 미래완료예요. (c) 옳음. 과거완료진행이 알맞아요. (d) 옳음. knew보다 앞선 일이라 had been이 맞아요. (e) 틀림: last night 같은 과거 시점 표현만 있고 기준 시점이 없어 has gone → went. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The train had left before we got to the platform.
(b) I have visited the museum twice before I was twelve.
(c) By the time you read this letter, I will have crossed the ocean.
(d) The children had been playing outside until their mother called them in.
(e) She will have finish the project by the deadline.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. got보다 먼저 떠났으므로 had left가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: was twelve가 과거 시점이므로 have visited → had visited. (c) 옳음. 시간 부사절은 현재시제, 주절은 미래완료예요. (d) 옳음. 과거완료진행이 알맞아요. (e) 틀림: will have 뒤에는 과거분사: finish → finished. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) When I turned on the TV, the game had already begun.
(b) I have been waiting for him for an hour when he finally showed up.
(c) By the time the sun sets, we will reach the top of the mountain.
(d) The doctor said that he has been working all night before the patient arrived.
(e) Scientists believe that robots will have replaced many jobs by 2050.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거 시점 이전에 시작되었으므로 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: showed up(과거) 기준이므로 have been waiting → had been waiting. (c) 옳음. 시간 부사절은 현재시제 sets이고 주절은 단순 미래라 알맞아요. (d) 틀림: arrived 이전부터의 동작이므로 has been working → had been working. (e) 옳음. 미래 시점까지 완료될 일이라 미래완료가 알맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) By next Friday, I will have read the whole novel.
(b) My grandmother told me that she had never flown before she visited me.
(c) The shop had been closed since Monday when we went there.
(d) When he got home, his mom has already cooked dinner.
(e) Mina had knew the truth for weeks before she told her mother.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 미래완료가 알맞아요. (b) 옳음. visited 이전의 경험이라 had flown이 맞아요. (c) 옳음. went 이전부터 계속된 상태라 had been closed가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: got(과거) 이전의 일이므로 has → had. (e) 틀림: had 뒤에는 과거분사: knew → known. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The boy realized that he (A)____ his umbrella on the bus. By the time he gets home, the rain (B)____.
items.exp: (A) realized(과거)보다 먼저 두고 내린 것이므로 had left예요. (B) by the time he gets home은 미래 시점이므로 will have stopped가 알맞아요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
By tomorrow noon, the workers (A)____ the road. When we passed by yesterday, they (B)____ it for three days.
choices: will have finished – have been repairing
will have finished – had been repaired
will have finished – had been repairing
items.exp: (A) 내일 정오라는 미래 시점까지 완료되므로 will have finished예요. (B) 어제 지나갔을 때(과거)까지 3일간 계속된 동작이므로 had been repairing이 알맞아요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 과거완료의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기>
Our neighbors [had lived] in Spain for six years when they moved to Korea.
choices: Mr. Park [had taught] at the school for twenty years when he retired.
They [had never met] a celebrity until Sam visited our school.
I [had lost] my bike, so I had to walk to school that day.
The bus [had already left] when Jane reached the stop.
She [had visited] Rome three times before she was ten.
items.exp: <보기>는 이사하기 전까지 6년간 살았다는 '계속'이에요. 정답은 은퇴할 때까지 20년간 가르쳤다는 '계속'이고, 나머지는 경험, 결과, 완료, 경험이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 과거완료의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: I [had never seen] such a huge dog before I visited the ranch.
She [had tried] bungee jumping twice before she turned fifteen.
Kevin [had broken] his leg, so he couldn't join the race.
He [had never eaten] sushi until his friend took him to the restaurant.
We [had met] the actor several times before he became famous.
items.exp: 다리가 부러진 결과로 경주에 참가하지 못했다는 '결과' 용법이에요. 나머지는 모두 그 시점 이전의 '경험'이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리가 도착했을 때 영화는 이미 시작되어 있었다.
items.s: The movie ___ when we arrived.
items.exp: 도착한 과거 시점보다 먼저 시작되었으므로 과거완료 had already started를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 다음 달이면 그는 이 회사에서 10년째 일하는 것이 된다.
items.s: By next month, he ___ at this company for ten years.
items.exp: 미래 시점까지 이어지는 일이므로 미래완료 will have worked를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리가 도착했을 때 아이들은 두 시간째 눈싸움을 하고 있던 중이었다.
items.s: The children ___ a snowball fight for two hours when we arrived.
items.exp: 과거 시점 이전부터 계속 진행 중이던 동작이므로 과거완료진행 had been having을 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The movie ended before we reached the cinema.
items.s: By the time we reached the cinema, the movie ___ .
items.exp: 먼저 끝난 일이므로 by the time 절의 과거 시점보다 앞선 과거완료 had ended를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: By the time the guests [will arrive], I will have set the table. → ___
a: By the time the guests arrive
items.exp: 시간의 부사절에서는 미래 대신 현재시제를 써서 arrive로 고쳐요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: He told me that he [has been] to Japan twice before he met me. → ___
a: He told me that he had been
items.exp: met(과거) 이전의 경험이므로 has been이 아니라 had been이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The ground is wet. It must rain last night.
It's a holiday tomorrow, so we must not get up early.
He can't be hungry. He has just had three burgers.
She should have went to the dentist earlier.
I may have a headache yesterday, but I'm fine now.
items.exp: 방금 햄버거를 세 개 먹었으니 '배고플 리가 없다'는 can't be가 알맞아요. 나머지는 must rain → must have rained, must not → don't have to, went → gone, may have → may have had로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Cindy may have call me last night, but I didn't hear the phone.
You may sit here if you want to.
Passengers must not use their phones during takeoff.
They ought not to have ignored the warning sign.
The thief cannot have entered through the window, because it was locked from inside.
items.exp: may have 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 해서 call → called로 고쳐야 해요. 나머지는 조동사 쓰임이 모두 알맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: Does he has to wear a tie at work?
You had not better stay up late tonight.
I may can help you after lunch.
You don't must wear a coat today; it's warm.
She didn't answer my call. She must have been asleep.
items.exp: 전화를 받지 않은 것에 대한 과거 사실의 강한 추측이므로 must have been이 맞아요. 나머지는 has → have, had not better → had better not, may can → may be able to, don't must → don't have to로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: We should have booked the tickets earlier; now they are sold out.
Sam can't be at school yesterday, because he was in the hospital.
Judy must be very proud of her son, who won the gold medal.
You may borrow my pen, but you must return it by Friday.
She shouldn't have told the secret to Ben, but she did.
items.exp: yesterday에 대한 과거 사실의 추측이므로 can't be가 아니라 can't have been이어야 해요. 나머지는 모두 알맞아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) You should have listened to the doctor's advice.
(b) She must have been tired; she fell asleep at once.
(c) The twins can't have been at the party; I saw them at the library.
(d) Soon, my sister will can ride a bike without help.
(e) He may has lost his key, so he is waiting outside.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거 사실에 대한 후회라 should have p.p.가 맞아요. (b) 옳음. 과거 사실에 대한 강한 추측이에요. (c) 옳음. 과거 사실에 대한 강한 부정 추측이에요. (d) 틀림: 조동사 두 개를 겹쳐 쓸 수 없어요. will can → will be able to. (e) 틀림: may 뒤에는 동사원형이나 have p.p.: may has lost → may have lost. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) He is able to swimming across the river.
(b) You must not bring your lunch; the school provides meals for free.
(c) We ought to have left earlier to avoid the traffic.
(d) The boy cannot have solved the puzzle by himself because it was too difficult.
(e) I should have went to bed earlier last night.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: be able to 뒤에는 동사원형: swimming → swim. (b) 틀림: '가져올 필요 없다'는 don't have to예요. must not → don't have to. (c) 옳음. ought to have p.p.는 과거에 하지 못한 일에 대한 후회예요. (d) 옳음. 과거 사실에 대한 강한 부정 추측이 알맞아요. (e) 틀림: should have 뒤에는 과거분사: went → gone. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (b), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) She may arrived at the station by now.
(b) The shirt might have shrunk in the wash.
(c) Does she has to leave right now?
(d) They would can speak French when they were young.
(e) You don't must hurry; the bus leaves in an hour.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: may 뒤에는 동사원형 또는 have p.p.: arrived → have arrived. (b) 옳음. might have p.p.는 과거에 대한 약한 추측이에요. (c) 틀림: does 뒤에는 동사원형: has → have. (d) 틀림: 조동사 두 개 연속 불가. would can → could 또는 were able to. (e) 틀림: must의 부정 의미 '필요 없다'는 don't have to예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He must have been a talented dancer when he was young.
(b) You may not to enter the lab without permission.
(c) I can't have left my bag on the bus, because I remember holding it at the gate.
(d) The room is so quiet. Everyone must sleeps now.
(e) They don't have to hurry; the show starts in an hour.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거 사실에 대한 강한 추측이에요. (b) 틀림: may not 뒤에는 동사원형: to enter → enter. (c) 옳음. 과거에 대한 강한 부정 추측이 알맞아요. (d) 틀림: must 뒤에는 동사원형: sleeps → be sleeping 또는 sleep. (e) 옳음. '서두를 필요 없다'는 don't have to예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Mina can't be happy. She won the first prize!
(b) You ought not to speak to your teacher like that.
(c) He should have spoke more politely at the meeting.
(d) This door must not be left open at night.
(e) I'm sorry. I may have taken your umbrella by mistake.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 1등을 한 상황이라 '행복할 리 없다'는 어색해요. can't be → must be. (b) 옳음. ought not to는 충고·금지를 나타내요. (c) 틀림: should have 뒤에는 과거분사: spoke → spoken. (d) 옳음. must not은 '~하면 안 된다'는 금지예요. (e) 옳음. 과거에 대한 약한 추측이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Visitors may take pictures, but they must not use a flash.
(b) Will you be able to attend the meeting next week?
(c) She cannot have eat the whole pizza; there is still half left.
(d) You should have told me the truth in the first place.
(e) The baby is crying. She must hungry.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. may는 허락, must not은 금지예요. (b) 옳음. will 뒤에는 can 대신 be able to를 써요. (c) 틀림: cannot have 뒤에는 과거분사: eat → eaten. (d) 옳음. 과거에 하지 못한 일에 대한 후회예요. (e) 틀림: 추측의 must 뒤에도 be가 필요해요: must hungry → must be hungry. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Look at the footprints. Someone (A)____ into the house last night. We (B)____ the door locked, but we forgot.
choices: must have come – should have kept
can't have come – should have kept
must have come – ought to keep
items.exp: (A) 발자국이라는 근거가 있어 과거에 대한 강한 추측 must have come이에요. (B) 잊었다고 했으므로 과거의 후회 should have kept가 맞아요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The park is free for everyone. Visitors (A)____ feed the animals because it is dangerous, but they (B)____ pay anything to enter.
choices: don't have to – don't have to
items.exp: (A) 동물에게 먹이를 주면 안 되므로 must not이에요. (B) 무료라서 낼 필요가 없으므로 don't have to가 알맞아요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 may의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기>
His father [may] be at the office now.
choices: You [may] enter the room after the bell rings.
Students [may] use dictionaries during the test.
items.exp: <보기>는 '~일지도 모른다'는 약한 추측이에요. 정답도 과거에 대한 추측이고, 나머지는 모두 '~해도 된다'는 허락이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 must의 의미가 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: You [must] wear a seat belt in the car.
He [must] be a genius; he solved it in a minute.
Students [must] keep quiet in the library.
All drivers [must] stop at a red light.
You [must] finish your homework before dinner.
items.exp: 정답은 '~임에 틀림없다'는 강한 추측이에요. 나머지는 모두 '~해야 한다'는 의무예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀가 그 책을 훔쳤을 리가 없다. 그녀는 그때 해외에 있었다.
items.s: She ___ the book. She was abroad then.
items.exp: 과거 사실에 대한 강한 부정 추측은 cannot have p.p.로 나타내요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리는 그때 더 일찍 출발했어야 했는데 그러지 못했다.
items.s: We ___ earlier then.
items.exp: 과거에 하지 못한 일에 대한 후회는 should have p.p.로 나타내요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I am sure that he was a soldier in his youth.
items.s: He ___ a soldier in his youth.
items.exp: 과거 사실에 대한 강한 추측은 must have p.p.예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Visitors are not required to take off their shoes here.
items.s: Visitors ___ off their shoes here.
items.exp: '~할 필요 없다'는 don't have to예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I'm sorry. I [may took] your seat by mistake. → ___
a: I'm sorry. I may have taken your seat by mistake.
items.exp: 과거에 대한 약한 추측은 may have p.p.이고 take의 과거분사는 taken이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: You will [can] enter the contest if you are over twelve. → ___
a: You will be able to enter the contest if you are over twelve.
items.exp: 조동사 will 뒤에 can을 같이 쓸 수 없어서 be able to로 바꿔요.

units.name: Ch2-2 used to, would like to, had better, would rather, may as well

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: There would be a small bakery at the corner of my old street.
He is used to get up early on weekends.
I would rather going to the beach than staying at home.
We may as well to take a taxi, because the bus is late.
You'd better not touch that wire; it's dangerous.
items.exp: had better의 부정은 had better not이에요. 나머지는 would be → used to be(과거의 상태), get up → getting up, going → go, to take → take로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The workers are used to work late at night, so they are not tired.
My grandfather used to take a walk every morning.
This brush is used to paint small details.
I would rather eat plain rice than eat food I don't like.
You had better not forget your passport at the hotel.
items.exp: '~하는 데 익숙하다'는 be used to + 동명사이므로 work → working이어야 해요. 나머지는 used to(습관), be used to + 동사원형(~하는 데 사용되다), would rather A than B, had better not이 모두 알맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: My sister would rather read a book than watching TV.
The little girl is used to being alone at home.
There used to being a river behind our school.
You may as well to try the new cake, since it's free.
Ann would like to being a vet in the future.
items.exp: be used to 뒤에 동명사 being이 와서 알맞아요. 나머지는 watching → watch, being → be, to try → try, being → be로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: Mr. Kim used to be a farmer before he became a mayor.
You had better not drink coffee at night.
I would rather stay up than miss the finale.
My grandmother would have long black hair when she was young.
Since the road is blocked, we may as well wait here.
items.exp: have(가지고 있다)는 상태를 나타내서 would를 쓸 수 없고 used to have여야 해요. would는 반복되는 습관에만 쓸 수 있어요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I used to be afraid of the dark.
(b) He is used to drive a truck on long trips.
(c) You'd better not make noise here.
(d) She would rather to quit than apologize.
(e) My family would like to visit Jeju next summer.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거의 상태는 used to + 동사원형이에요. (b) 틀림: 익숙함을 나타내므로 drive → driving. (c) 옳음. had better not + 동사원형이 맞아요. (d) 틀림: would rather 뒤에는 동사원형: to quit → quit. (e) 옳음. would like to + 동사원형이 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) We had better to leave before it gets dark.
(b) A knife is used to cut vegetables.
(c) I would rather have tea than coffee.
(d) There would be a huge tree in front of the gate.
(e) If you are tired, you may as well go to bed.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: had better 뒤에는 to가 없어요. to leave → leave. (b) 옳음. be used to + 동사원형은 '~하는 데 사용되다'예요. (c) 옳음. would rather A than B에서 A, B 모두 동사원형이에요. (d) 틀림: 과거의 상태는 used to be여야 해요. would be → used to be. (e) 옳음. may as well + 동사원형이 맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) You not had better ignore the warning.
(b) Jina is used to getting up at five.
(c) We would rather to go by train.
(d) Lucy used to playing the violin every day.
(e) I would like see the new movie tonight.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 부정은 had better not: not had better → had better not. (b) 옳음. be used to + 동명사(~하는 데 익숙하다)가 맞아요. (c) 틀림: would rather 뒤에는 동사원형: to go → go. (d) 틀림: used to 뒤에는 동사원형: playing → play. (e) 틀림: would like 뒤에 to가 필요: see → to see. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Our team used to practice twice a week, but now it practices daily.
(b) You would better wear a helmet when riding a bike.
(c) She would rather skip lunch than eat in a noisy place.
(d) My dad is used to work on weekends.
(e) Ben would often bring me flowers when we were students.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거의 습관 used to + 동사원형이에요. (b) 틀림: would better가 아니라 had better여야 해요. (c) 옳음. would rather A than B에서 A, B 모두 동사원형이에요. (d) 틀림: 익숙함은 be used to + 동명사: work → working. (e) 옳음. 반복되는 과거의 습관에는 would를 쓸 수 있어요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I'd rather not talk about the accident now.
(b) We may as well going home; the shop is closed.
(c) This machine is used to make ice cream.
(d) Tom would be a shy boy, but he is outgoing now.
(e) The old man is used to living alone.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. would rather의 부정은 would rather not이에요. (b) 틀림: may as well 뒤에는 동사원형: going → go. (c) 옳음. be used to + 동사원형은 '~하는 데 사용되다'예요. (d) 틀림: 과거의 상태는 used to be여야 해요. would be → used to be. (e) 옳음. be used to + 동명사가 맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I'd rather stay here than going out.
(b) Mr. Lee used to be my neighbor, but he moved last year.
(c) You had better take an umbrella with you.
(d) They would like having a picnic in the park this Sunday.
(e) If nobody is coming, we might as well start the meeting.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: than 뒤에도 동사원형: going → go. (b) 옳음. 과거의 상태는 used to be예요. (c) 옳음. had better + 동사원형이 맞아요. (d) 틀림: would like 뒤에는 to부정사: having → to have. (e) 옳음. might as well + 동사원형이 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
My uncle (A)____ a smoker, but he quit last year. Now he is (B)____ jogging every morning.
choices: is used to be – used to
used to be – used to be
items.exp: (A) 과거의 상태는 used to be예요. (B) 지금 조깅에 익숙하다는 뜻이므로 be used to + 동명사의 used to가 알맞아요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
You (A)____ not park here, or you will get a ticket. I (B)____ walk than pay for parking.
items.exp: (A) 충고의 had better not이에요. (B) walk than pay처럼 than과 함께 쓰는 것은 would rather A than B예요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기>
My father [used to] play baseball in college.
choices: I am [used to] waking up early.
This tool is [used to] open cans.
There [used to] be a cinema on this street.
He is [used to] speaking in public.
Jina is [used to] cooking for a large family.
items.exp: <보기>는 과거의 습관을 나타내는 used to + 동사원형이에요. 정답은 과거의 상태를 나타내는 used to be이고, 나머지는 '익숙하다'(be used to + 동명사) 또는 '사용되다'(be used to + 동사원형)예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: Mina [is used to] dealing with angry customers.
We [are used to] eating dinner late.
He soon [got used to] the cold weather.
This pen [is used to] sign important documents.
They [are used to] living in a small house.
items.exp: 정답은 '~하는 데 사용되다'(be used to + 동사원형)이고, 나머지는 모두 '~에 익숙하다'(be used to + 동명사/명사)예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 어렸을 때 매일 이 강에서 수영하곤 했다.
items.s: I ___ in this river every day when I was young.
items.exp: 과거의 반복되는 습관은 used to + 동사원형 또는 would + 동사원형으로 나타내요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 버스가 안 오니, 우리는 걸어가는 편이 낫겠다.
items.s: The bus isn't coming, so we ___ .
items.exp: '~하는 편이 낫다'는 may(might) as well + 동사원형이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 너는 지금 그녀에게 그 일에 대해 말하지 않는 것이 좋겠다.
items.s: You ___ her about it now.
items.exp: had better의 부정은 had better not이고 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 낯선 도시에서 혼자 사는 데 익숙하다.
items.s: He ___ alone in a strange city.
items.exp: '~하는 데 익숙하다'는 be used to + 동명사예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My brother [is used to] be a pilot, but now he drives a taxi. → ___
a: My brother used to be a pilot
items.exp: 과거의 상태는 used to + 동사원형이에요. 뒤에 be가 있으므로 is used to → used to로 고쳐요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: You [not had better] spend all your money on snacks. → ___
a: You had better not spend all your money on snacks
items.exp: had better의 부정형은 had better not이에요.

units.name: Ch3-1 수동태의 기본 · 다양한 형태 · 동사구 수동태

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The accident was happened at the crossroads.
The cake has been ate by someone.
A new road is being built near our school.
The letter will be send to you next week.
The baby was looked by her aunt.
items.exp: 진행형 수동태 is being built가 알맞아요. 나머지는 was happened → happened(자동사는 수동태 불가), ate → eaten, send → sent, looked → looked after로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The old castle is visited by thousands of tourists every year.
The project has not been completed yet.
My little brother was laughed at by the other kids.
The meeting was put off because of the typhoon.
The new stadium is being built since last year.
items.exp: since last year처럼 과거부터 지금까지 이어지는 표현과는 현재완료 수동태 has been built를 써요. is being built는 지금 진행 중인 일에 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: The assignment was handed out by the teacher.
My plan was carried by my teammates.
The puppy was taken care by a kind neighbor.
The leader is looked up by his members.
The stray cat was run by a car.
items.exp: 동사구 hand out은 하나의 동사처럼 수동태로 바꿔요. 나머지는 carried → carried out, care → care of, looked up → looked up to, run → run over로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: Spanish is spoken in many countries.
The thief was caught by the police last night.
The photos should be kept in a safe place.
The vase has been breaking by my cat.
The dessert is being prepared by the chef now.
items.exp: 완료형 수동태는 have(has) been + 과거분사이므로 breaking → broken이어야 해요. 나머지는 모두 알맞아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞는 것은?
choices: Smoking will be allowed not in this building.
Your order is processing now, so please wait.
The window has been broke by a stone.
The doors are lock at ten every night.
The movie wasn't finished before the power went out.
items.exp: 과거 수동태 부정문 wasn't finished가 알맞아요. 나머지는 will be allowed not → will not be allowed, processing → being processed, broke → broken, lock → locked로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The broken window has been repaired.
(b) The new songs are being sing by the children.
(c) This dictionary can used for free.
(d) The heater was turned off by the manager.
(e) The mystery has not solved yet.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 현재완료 수동태가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: 진행형 수동태는 being + 과거분사: sing → sung. (c) 틀림: 조동사 수동태는 can be used: can used → can be used. (d) 옳음. 동사구 turn off는 하나의 동사처럼 수동태로 바꿔요. (e) 틀림: 현재완료 수동태는 has not been solved: solved 앞에 been이 필요해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) A strange noise was heard from the attic.
(b) The students were been given a surprise quiz.
(c) This room will cleaned by the staff tomorrow.
(d) The wet floor was cleaned up by a worker.
(e) Their plan was made use by the club.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거 수동태가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: were been이 아니라 were given이에요. (c) 틀림: 미래형 수동태는 will be + 과거분사: will cleaned → will be cleaned. (d) 옳음. clean up이 하나의 동사처럼 수동태가 되었어요. (e) 틀림: make use of의 수동태에는 of가 필요: made use → made use of. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The song is loved by people all over the world.
(b) The exam has been put off until next week.
(c) The tower was struck by lightning twice last year.
(d) My bike is being fixed by Dad now.
(e) Our dog is taken good care by my aunt.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 현재 수동태가 맞아요. (b) 옳음. put off의 현재완료 수동태가 맞아요. (c) 옳음. 과거 수동태가 맞아요. (d) 옳음. 현재진행형 수동태가 맞아요. (e) 틀림: take good care of의 수동태에는 of가 필요: good care → good care of. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The old photo was found in a box under the bed.
(b) Many trees have been planted by volunteers last spring.
(c) The garden must be watered every morning.
(d) This room is being clean by the staff right now.
(e) Our teacher is looked up to by all the students.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거 수동태가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: last spring과 현재완료는 함께 쓸 수 없어요. have been planted → were planted. (c) 옳음. 조동사 수동태 must be + 과거분사예요. (d) 틀림: 진행형 수동태: clean → cleaned. (e) 옳음. look up to의 수동태가 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The children were laughed at by the bigger boys.
(b) The accident was happened on a rainy night.
(c) The song will be played at the end of the show.
(d) My notebook was belonged to my sister.
(e) The windows have been cleaned by the workers.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. laugh at의 수동태가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: happen은 자동사라 수동태가 안 돼요. was happened → happened. (c) 옳음. 미래형 수동태가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: belong to는 수동태가 안 돼요. was belonged → belonged. (e) 옳음. 현재완료 수동태가 맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Is the dinner being prepared by Mom?
(b) Has the problem been solved by the team?
(c) The gym will be use for the school festival.
(d) The painting was stolen from the museum last night.
(e) Rice is grown many countries in Asia.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 진행형 수동태 의문문이에요. (b) 옳음. 현재완료 수동태 의문문이에요. (c) 틀림: will be 뒤에는 과거분사: use → used. (d) 옳음. 과거 수동태가 맞아요. (e) 틀림: 수동태에서도 전치사가 필요: grown many → grown in many. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The new menu (A)____ by the chef now. It (B)____ to customers next week.
choices: is being made – will be introduced
has being made – will be introduced
items.exp: (A) now가 있고 메뉴가 만들어지는 대상이므로 진행형 수동태 is being made예요. (B) 미래형 수동태는 will be + 과거분사예요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
These photos (A)____ in this box since 2010. The old album (B)____ in the attic by my mom last week.
choices: have been kept – has been found
items.exp: (A) since 2010이 있어 현재완료 수동태 have been kept예요. (B) last week가 있어 과거 수동태 was found예요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The bridge (A)____ in 1985, and it (B)____ now because of cracks.
choices: has been built – is being repaired
items.exp: (A) 1985년이라는 과거 시점이 있으므로 과거 수동태 was built예요. (B) now가 있고 다리가 수리되는 대상이므로 is being repaired예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 영화의 결말은 지금 감독에 의해 쓰이고 있는 중이다.
items.s: The ending of the movie ___ by the director.
items.exp: 진행 중인 일의 수동태는 be동사 + being + 과거분사이므로 is being written이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 다리는 지금까지 세 번 보수되었다.
items.s: The bridge ___ three times so far.
items.exp: so far와 함께 쓰는 현재완료 수동태 has been repaired예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이 규칙들은 모든 학생에게 지켜져야 한다.
items.s: These rules ___ by all students.
items.exp: 조동사 수동태는 조동사 + be + 과거분사예요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 수동태로 바꿔 쓸 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The neighbors looked after the baby while we were away.
items.s: The baby ___ by the neighbors while we were away.
items.exp: 동사구 look after는 하나의 동사처럼 취급해 was looked after로 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The hotel [is built] right now by a famous company. → ___
items.exp: right now가 있어 진행 중이므로 진행형 수동태 is being built로 고쳐요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The shy boy was [laughed] by his classmates. → ___
items.exp: 동사구 laugh at은 수동태에서도 at이 필요해서 laughed at이에요

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: A beautiful scarf was bought for my mother by my father.
My mother was bought a beautiful scarf by my father.
The children were cooked a special dinner by Grandpa.
A funny story was told for the kids by the clown.
Two tickets were offered of her by the manager.
items.exp: buy는 직접목적어만 수동태 주어가 될 수 있고 간접목적어 앞에 for를 써요. 나머지는 bought a scarf → 사람 주어 불가, cooked → 사람 주어 불가, told for → told to, offered of → offered to로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: She was taught the guitar by her uncle.
The question was asked of the speaker by the audience.
I was found a seat by the usher.
A sweater was made for me by my grandma.
The children were shown a magic trick by the clown.
items.exp: find는 직접목적어만 주어가 될 수 있어 A seat was found for me by the usher.로 써야 해요. teach, show는 간접목적어도 주어가 될 수 있고, ask는 of를 써요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞는 것은?
choices: The boy was made clean the room by his mother.
The girl was seen sing on the stage.
We were told wait outside by the guard.
The singer was called a queen of pop by fans.
The man was heard shout for help by the neighbors.
items.exp: 명사 보어는 수동태에서 그대로 써서 알맞아요. 나머지는 clean → to clean, sing → to sing(또는 singing), wait → to wait, shout → to shout(또는 shouting)로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: My neighbor was seen to enter the building.
The soldier was ordered stay at the gate.
My neighbor was seen entering the building.
The children were made to apologize to the teacher.
The cat was named Mimi by the girl.
items.exp: tell류 동사의 목적격보어 to부정사는 수동태에서도 to를 써야 해요. stay → to stay. 지각동사의 보어가 원형이면 to부정사로, 현재분사이면 그대로 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: Mina was told by her teacher keep quiet.
The room was kept warmly by the heater.
My brother was made feeling guilty by the news.
The kids were heard to laughing in the yard.
He was elected the captain of the team by the players.
items.exp: 명사 보어는 그대로 쓰므로 알맞아요. 나머지는 keep → to keep, warmly → warm, feeling → to feel, to laughing → to laugh(또는 laughing)로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) A letter was sent to him by his pen pal.
(b) He was bought a camera by his parents.
(c) The students were taught English by a native speaker.
(d) I was seen to cross the street by my teacher.
(e) The baby was heard cry in the night.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. send는 직접목적어를 주어로 쓰고 간접목적어 앞에 to를 써요. (b) 틀림: buy는 사람을 주어로 할 수 없어요. A camera was bought for him by his parents. (c) 옳음. teach는 간접목적어를 주어로 쓸 수 있어요. (d) 옳음. 지각동사 보어 원형은 수동태에서 to부정사가 돼요. (e) 틀림: cry → to cry 또는 crying. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The girl was called Angel by her grandfather.
(b) A cake was made me by my dad.
(c) He was told to wait in the lobby.
(d) The boys were made run ten laps.
(e) A new bike was bought for him by his uncle.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 명사 보어는 그대로 써요. (b) 틀림: made me → made for me. (c) 옳음. to부정사 보어는 그대로 써요. (d) 틀림: 사역동사의 원형 보어는 수동태에서 to부정사: run → to run. (e) 옳음. 직접목적어 주어 + for가 맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I was given a ride to the station by Jake.
(b) The players were told to gather in the gym.
(c) A hot meal was cooked for the workers by the volunteers.
(d) The fire was seen to spread quickly by the villagers.
(e) She was made smile by the clown's joke.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. give는 간접목적어를 주어로 쓸 수 있어요. (b) 옳음. to부정사 보어는 그대로 써요. (c) 옳음. cook은 직접목적어 주어 + for예요. (d) 옳음. 지각동사 원형 보어는 to부정사가 돼요. (e) 틀림: 사역동사 수동태에서는 smile → to smile. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Free gifts were given to all customers by the shop.
(b) Each student was bought a notebook by the school.
(c) The children were seen play in the garden.
(d) I was made to wash the car by my brother.
(e) A nice present was given for me by my aunt.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 직접목적어를 주어로 하면 to를 써요. (b) 틀림: buy는 사람 주어 불가: A notebook was bought for each student by the school. (c) 틀림: play → to play 또는 playing. (d) 옳음. 사역동사 수동태의 to부정사가 맞아요. (e) 틀림: give는 to를 써요: for me → to me. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The cat was found sleeping under the sofa.
(b) A lunch box was cooked to her by her father.
(c) They were told to keep their seats.
(d) The workers were made to working overtime.
(e) A new pen was bought for me by my aunt.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 현재분사 보어는 그대로 써요. (b) 틀림: cook은 for를 써요: to her → for her. (c) 옳음. to부정사 보어는 그대로 써요. (d) 틀림: made to working → made to work. (e) 옳음. buy는 직접목적어 주어 + for예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He was called a hero by the press.
(b) A cup of tea was made to me by Grandma.
(c) Tom was bought a new bike by his uncle.
(d) The boy was seen to run into the shop.
(e) Sam was offered a job by the company.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 명사 보어를 그대로 써요. (b) 틀림: make는 for를 써요: to me → for me. (c) 틀림: buy는 사람을 주어로 할 수 없어요. (d) 옳음. 지각동사 원형 보어는 to부정사가 돼요. (e) 옳음. offer는 간접목적어를 주어로 쓸 수 있어요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
A new bike (A)____ me by my uncle, and I (B)____ to ride it carefully.
items.exp: (A) buy는 직접목적어를 주어로 하고 for를 써서 was bought for예요. (B) 나는 '듣는' 입장이므로 수동태 was told + to부정사예요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The thief was seen (A)____ a window, and his partner was made (B)____ the bag.
items.exp: (A) 지각동사 see의 원형 보어는 수동태에서 to break가 돼요. (B) 사역동사 make의 원형 보어도 수동태에서 to carry가 돼요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The little girl (A)____ Rosie by her grandparents. A new doll (B)____ her by them.
choices: was called to – was given to
items.exp: (A) 5형식 수동태는 was called + 명사 보어예요. (B) give는 직접목적어 주어일 때 간접목적어 앞에 to를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 아이들은 선생님께 조용히 하라는 말을 들었다.
items.s: The children ___ quiet by the teacher.
items.exp: tell의 수동태는 were told이고 목적격보어 to be quiet은 그대로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 소년은 그 가게로 달려 들어가는 것이 목격되었다.
items.s: The boy ___ into the shop.
items.exp: 지각동사의 원형 보어는 수동태에서 to부정사가 되어 was seen to run이에요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 수동태로 바꿔 쓸 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: My uncle cooked us a big dinner.
items.s: A big dinner ___ us by my uncle.
items.exp: cook은 직접목적어만 주어가 되고 간접목적어 앞에 for를 써요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 수동태로 바꿔 쓸 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The coach made the players run in the rain.
items.s: The players ___ in the rain by the coach.
items.exp: 사역동사의 원형 보어는 수동태에서 to부정사가 돼요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: A question was asked [to] the mayor by the reporter. → ___
items.exp: ask는 직접목적어를 주어로 할 때 간접목적어 앞에 of를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The boys were told [clean] the classroom by the teacher. → ___
items.exp: tell의 목적격보어는 to부정사이므로 수동태에서도 to clean으로 써요.

units.name: Ch3-3 that절 수동태 · by 이외의 전치사

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The mountain is covered with snow all year round.
He is interested to science fiction movies.
The pool was filled by cold water.
Mina was surprised with the loud noise.
I am tired with the same lunch every day.
items.exp: be covered with가 알맞아요. 나머지는 interested to → interested in, filled by → filled with, surprised with → surprised at, tired with → tired of로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Jejudo is known for its beautiful beaches.
The singer is known to young people around the world.
The village is known as its sweet apples.
He is known as a great inventor.
My parents are satisfied with my report card.
items.exp: '~로 유명하다'는 이유를 나타내는 be known for예요. as는 '~로서(자격)'를 나타내요. 나머지는 모두 알맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: It is said that the actor to be in Paris now.
Mina is said to has won the contest.
It is thought that the bridge to be built in 1990.
The box was filled by old toys.
The old man is believed to have been a pilot when he was young.
items.exp: 믿는 시점(현재)보다 조종사였던 때가 앞서므로 to have been이 알맞아요. 나머지는 to be → is, has → have, to be built → was built, filled by → filled with로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: It is believed that honesty is the best policy.
She is said to be a good singer when she was a child.
Dolphins are said to be very intelligent.
The workers are thought to have finished the job yesterday.
It is said that the old house was built in 1900.
items.exp: said(현재)보다 어렸을 때(과거)가 앞서므로 to be가 아니라 to have been이어야 해요. 나머지는 모두 알맞아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞는 것은?
choices: The shop owner was pleased to the sales.
The mountain is said that very high.
She was surprised in the result.
It is said that the museum is closed on Mondays.
The jar is made with glass.
items.exp: It is said that + 절 형태가 알맞아요. 나머지는 pleased to → pleased with, is said that → is said to be, in → at, with → of로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) It is said that the café opens at seven.
(b) The thief is believed to have hidden in the forest.
(c) He was pleased in the gift.
(d) The man is said to had a lot of money.
(e) This ring is made of gold.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 가주어 It을 쓴 that절 수동태가 맞아요. (b) 옳음. 믿는 시점보다 앞선 일이라 to have p.p.가 알맞아요. (c) 틀림: in → with (be pleased with). (d) 틀림: to 뒤에는 동사원형 또는 have p.p.: to had → to have. (e) 옳음. 재료의 성질이 변하지 않으면 be made of예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The room was filled with the smell of fresh bread.
(b) It is believed that the dog to be nine years old.
(c) Paper is made from wood.
(d) My sister is interested in space travel.
(e) Mr. Kim is said to have a famous painter ten years ago.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. be filled with가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: that절에는 정동사가 와요: to be → is. (c) 옳음. 화학적 변화를 거쳐 만들어지면 be made from이에요. (d) 옳음. be interested in이 맞아요. (e) 틀림: 10년 전의 일이므로 to have → to have been. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) She is tired for waiting in the long line.
(b) The singer is known to as a role model.
(c) Tom is said to be very strong when he was younger.
(d) It is thought that the actor have written the script.
(e) The jar is filled with cookies.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: tired for → tired of. (b) 틀림: known to as → known as. (c) 틀림: 과거의 일이므로 to be → to have been. (d) 틀림: that절 주어 the actor는 단수라 have → has. (e) 옳음. be filled with가 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (e) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Our town is known for its traditional market.
(b) The teacher was satisfied with the students' answers.
(c) It is believed that cats can see well in the dark.
(d) The boy is said to has been ill for a week.
(e) The glass was filled by orange juice.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. be known for(~로 유명하다)가 맞아요. (b) 옳음. be satisfied with가 맞아요. (c) 옳음. 가주어 It을 쓴 that절 수동태가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: to 뒤에는 have been: has → have. (e) 틀림: filled by → filled with. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He is known as the best chef in town.
(b) Everyone was surprised for the news.
(c) The boy is believed to have lost his way in the fog.
(d) It is said that the soup to be too salty.
(e) She was disappointed with the final result.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 자격을 나타내는 be known as가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: for → at (be surprised at). (c) 옳음. 믿는 시점보다 앞선 일이라 to have lost가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: that절에는 정동사: to be → is. (e) 옳음. be disappointed with가 맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This table is made of oak.
(b) The lake is said that it is very deep.
(c) The man is believed to have been a pirate.
(d) She is interested on traditional music.
(e) The students are tired about homework.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 형태가 유지되는 재료는 be made of예요. (b) 틀림: The lake is said to be very deep. 또는 It is said that the lake is very deep. (c) 옳음. 믿는 시점보다 앞선 일이라 to have been이 맞아요. (d) 틀림: on → in. (e) 틀림: about → of (be tired of). 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Ms. Han (A)____ to (B)____ a famous dancer when she was young.
items.exp: (A) 수동태 is said예요. (B) 젊었을 때(과거)가 말하는 시점(현재)보다 앞서므로 완료부정사 to have been이 알맞아요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The hall was filled (A)____ visitors, and everyone was surprised (B)____ the size of the crowd.
items.exp: be filled with(~로 가득 차다), be surprised at(~에 놀라다)이에요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
This soup is known (A)____ Koreans, and it is also known (B)____ a cure for hangovers.
items.exp: (A) 알려진 대상(사람들)에게는 be known to예요. (B) 자격(~로서)을 나타낼 때는 be known as예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 배우는 젊었을 때 가수였다고 한다.
items.s: The actor is said ___ a singer when he was young.
items.exp: said(현재)보다 이전의 일이므로 완료부정사 to have been을 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: People believe that the old tree is very strong.
items.s: The old tree is believed ___ very strong.
items.exp: that절의 주어를 문장의 주어로 하고 동사는 to부정사로 바꾸어요. 시제가 같으므로 to be예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 방은 오래된 책들로 가득 차 있었다.
items.s: The room ___ old books.
items.exp: '~로 가득 차 있다'는 be filled with예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 가수는 전 세계 사람들에게 알려져 있다.
items.s: The singer ___ people all over the world.
items.exp: 알려진 대상이 사람일 때는 be known to예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Wine is made [of] grapes. → ___
items.exp: 재료가 화학적으로 변해서 원래 형태를 알아볼 수 없으면 be made from이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: It is said that she [is] a brave soldier in her youth. → ___
a: It is said that she was a brave soldier in her youth.
items.exp: in her youth는 과거이므로 that절의 동사는 was로 고쳐요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The teacher showed us how we should solve the problem.
My plan is to saving money for a trip.
I need a pen to write.
I don't know where going next.
I found it hard solve the problem.
items.exp: 'how + 주어 + should + 동사원형'은 how to solve와 같은 의미로 알맞아요. 나머지는 saving → save, write → write with, going → to go, hard solve → hard to solve로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Her dream is to become a famous scientist.
It was kind of you to help the old woman.
He needs a friend to talk with.
I don't know what do next.
The doctor advised me not to eat late at night.
items.exp: 의문사 뒤에는 to부정사가 와야 해요. what do → what to do. 나머지는 모두 알맞아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞는 것은?
choices: This app makes easy to check the weather.
I want something cold to drink.
Please tell me when starting the meeting.
There is nothing to be afraid.
items.exp: -thing + 형용사 + to부정사 순서로 알맞아요. 나머지는 makes easy → makes it easy, starting → to start, afraid → afraid of, swimming → to swim으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: We are to meet at the station at noon.
You are to hand in the report by Friday.
No one was to be seen in the park.
If you are to win, you should practice hard.
He is to going to Spain next week.
items.exp: be to 용법 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 해요. to going → to go. 나머지는 각각 예정, 의무, 가능, 의도의 be to 용법으로 알맞아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I forgot what to say.
(b) Jisu found it hard to wake up early.
(c) We discussed where going for lunch.
(d) My plan is not to tell her the truth.
(e) He has nothing to worry.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 의문사 + to부정사가 목적어로 쓰였어요. (b) 옳음. 가목적어 it과 진목적어 to부정사예요. (c) 틀림: 의문사 뒤에는 to부정사: going → to go. (d) 옳음. to부정사의 부정은 not to예요. (e) 틀림: worry about이므로 to worry → to worry about. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Is there anything to drink in the fridge?
(b) It is difficult of him to say sorry.
(c) I asked her where to go.
(d) She told me not go outside.
(e) We need a house to live.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. -thing + to부정사가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: difficult는 for를 써요. of him → for him. (c) 옳음. 의문사 + to부정사가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: to부정사의 부정은 not to: not go → not to go. (e) 틀림: live in이므로 to live → to live in. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) He made it possible to finish early.
(b) She wants to know how to using the machine.
(c) There are many places visiting in Seoul.
(d) I have a lot of friends to help me.
(e) It was necessary that to wear a helmet.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 가목적어 it과 진목적어 to finish예요. (b) 틀림: how 뒤에는 to부정사: to using → to use. (c) 틀림: 명사를 수식하는 to부정사: visiting → to visit. (d) 옳음. 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미는 to부정사예요. (e) 틀림: 가주어 It 뒤에는 that 없이 to wear: that to wear → to wear. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) To read books every day is not easy.
(b) I think necessary to study English.
(c) The lady asked me which bus to take.
(d) She has a house to live in.
(e) I can't decide when going.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. to부정사가 주어로 쓰였어요. (b) 틀림: 가목적어 it이 필요해요: think necessary → think it necessary. (c) 옳음. which + to부정사가 목적어로 쓰였어요. (d) 옳음. live in처럼 전치사가 남아야 해요. (e) 틀림: when 뒤에는 to부정사: going → to go. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) His job is to take care of the animals.
(b) It is not good to eating too much sugar.
(c) I don't know whom to ask for help.
(d) She has a lot of work do today.
(e) They have an important matter to discuss.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. to부정사가 보어로 쓰였어요. (b) 틀림: 진주어는 to부정사: to eating → to eat. (c) 옳음. whom + to부정사가 맞아요. (d) 틀림: 명사를 수식하는 to부정사: do → to do. (e) 옳음. discuss는 타동사라 전치사가 필요 없어요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He didn't know to do what.
(b) Do you have anything to tell me?
(c) I found it strange to see him there.
(d) The kids need a room to play.
(e) Our plan is to leave before dawn.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 의문사가 앞에 와야 해요: what to do. (b) 옳음. -thing + to부정사가 맞아요. (c) 옳음. 가목적어 it과 진목적어 to see예요. (d) 틀림: play in이므로 to play → to play in. (e) 옳음. to부정사가 보어로 쓰였어요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The new rule makes (A)____ hard to share files. I don't have any pen (B)____ with.
items.exp: (A) 가목적어는 it이에요. (B) 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미는 to부정사이므로 to write with가 알맞아요.

items.q:
다음 글의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The class discussed (A)____ to solve the problem. The teacher told us (B)____ to panic.
items.exp: (A) '어떻게 풀지'는 how to solve예요. (B) to부정사의 부정은 not to panic이에요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 to부정사의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기>
She has a lot of homework [to do] today.
choices: His dream is [to be] a pilot.
I have a few books [to read] this week.
items.exp: <보기>는 명사 homework를 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이에요. 정답도 books를 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이고, 나머지는 목적어, 보어, 주어, 목적어 역할의 명사적 용법이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 to부정사의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: My goal is [to win] the championship.
[To keep] a diary is a good habit.
She has no friend [to rely on].
We plan [to visit] Jeju this winter.
items.exp: 정답은 명사 friend를 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이고, 나머지는 보어, 목적어, 주어, 목적어 역할의 명사적 용법이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 어디에 주차해야 할지 몰라서 경찰관에게 물었다.
items.s: He didn't know ___ , so he asked a police officer.
items.exp: '어디에 ~할지'는 where + to부정사 또는 where + 주어 + should + 동사원형이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 빗속에서 외출하는 것이 위험하다는 것을 알게 되었다.
items.s: I found ___ in the rain.
items.exp: 가목적어 it을 쓰고 진목적어 to부정사를 뒤로 보내요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 아기에게는 가지고 놀 장난감이 하나도 없다.
items.s: The baby has no toy ___ .
items.exp: 명사를 수식하는 to부정사이고, play with처럼 전치사를 남겨 두어야 해요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: To get up early is hard for me.
items.s: It is hard for me ___ .
items.exp: 주어로 쓰인 to부정사를 뒤로 보내고 가주어 It을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The doctor advised me [don't to] eat late at night. → ___
a: not to eat late at night
items.exp: to부정사의 부정은 to부정사 바로 앞에 not을 써서 not to로 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I'm looking for a quiet room to [study]. → ___
items.exp: 수식받는 명사 room이 전치사 in의 목적어이므로 study in으로 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: My grandfather lived to be ninety-eight years old.
The puzzle is easy enough for a child to solve it.
The runners were too tired to climb the last hill.
To make matters worse, the bus broke down halfway.
He was kind enough to lend me his umbrella.
items.exp: enough to 구문에서 for a child는 solve의 의미상 주어이고, 목적어는 문장의 주어 The puzzle이에요. 그래서 목적어 it이 중복되어 틀려요. it을 지워야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He is enough rich to buy the whole building.
The lake was too cold for us swim in.
The test was so difficult to finish within an hour.
Strange saying, my dog never barks at strangers.
She is old enough to travel abroad by herself.
items.exp: enough는 형용사 뒤에 와요(rich enough). 의미상 주어는 for us to swim, so 뒤에는 that절이 와야 하고(too difficult to finish), 독립부정사는 Strange to say예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: I was surprised to find the door unlocked.
You must be crazy to go out in this storm.
She hurried to the station only to find the train gone.
He turned off his phone so as not to being disturbed.
To get a good seat, you should arrive early.
items.exp: so as not to 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 being이 아니라 be가 맞아요. 나머지는 각각 감정의 원인, 판단의 근거, 결과, 조건·목적의 to부정사로 옳아요.

items.q: 어법상 옳지 않은 문장을 고르세요.
choices: He needs a pen to write.
He has no friends to talk with.
The boy was never to see his father again.
You are not to enter the lab without permission.
Nothing was to be heard but the sound of rain.
items.exp: to부정사가 꾸미는 명사가 전치사의 목적어 역할이면 전치사를 남겨야 해요. a pen to write with가 맞아요. 나머지는 be + to부정사의 운명·의무·가능 용법이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The old man was too weak for walk without help.
(b) He studied hard enough to pass the entrance exam.
(c) My uncle was so wise to give up his seat for her.
(d) She must be a genius to solve such a hard problem.
(e) To tell the truth, I have never been to Busan.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: for walk → for him to walk. 의미상 주어 뒤에는 to부정사가 와요. (b) 옳음: enough가 부사 hard 뒤에 있고 to부정사가 이어져요. (c) 틀림: so는 that절과 쓰므로 wise enough to give 또는 wise to give가 되어야 해요. (d) 옳음: 판단의 근거를 나타내는 to부정사예요. (e) 옳음: 문장 전체를 수식하는 독립부정사예요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (b), (d), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) He studied hard so as not fail the exam.
(b) Not to mention the fee, the course is too long.
(c) She is smart enough passing the test easily.
(d) The girl grew up become a famous architect.
(e) The soup tasted too good that I ate it all.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: so as not to fail이어야 해요. (b) 옳음: 독립부정사 Not to mention은 옳아요. (c) 틀림: enough 뒤에는 to pass가 와요. (d) 틀림: 결과의 to부정사 grew up to become이어야 해요. (e) 틀림: that절과는 so ... that을 써야 해요(so good that). 따라서 틀린 문장은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) If you are to succeed in business, you must be honest.
(b) The key was nowhere to find.
(c) To begin with, the plan costs too much money.
(d) The children were happy to receiving gifts from their grandparents.
(e) She is too proud asking for help.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: be + to부정사의 의도 용법이에요. (b) 틀림: 열쇠는 '발견되는' 대상이므로 to be found가 되어야 해요. (c) 옳음: 독립부정사 to begin with(우선)이에요. (d) 틀림: to 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 해요(to receive). (e) 틀림: too proud to ask for help가 되어야 해요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The coffee was too bitter for her to drink.
(b) The reporter ran to the scene for take pictures.
(c) You are not to park your car in front of the gate.
(d) He woke up to find himself in a strange room.
(e) She is enough tall to reach the top shelf.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: too ... for 목적격 to 구문이에요. 목적어 it이 없는 것도 맞아요. (b) 틀림: 목적은 to take pictures로 나타내요. (c) 옳음: be + to부정사의 의무(금지) 용법이에요. (d) 옳음: 결과를 나타내는 to부정사예요. (e) 틀림: tall enough to reach의 어순이에요. 따라서 정답은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) She woke up early so as not to miss the first train.
(b) Not to mention of the cost, the trip was too tiring.
(c) He must be careless to leaving the window open.
(d) To make matters worse, my phone ran out of battery.
(e) The tea was too hot that I couldn't drink it.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: so as not to + 동사원형으로 맞아요. (b) 틀림: Not to mention 뒤에는 of 없이 목적어가 바로 와요. (c) 틀림: 판단의 근거 to 뒤에는 동사원형 leave가 와요. (d) 옳음: 독립부정사 표현이 옳아요. (e) 틀림: that절과는 so hot that이 되어야 해요. 따라서 정답은 (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The stadium is large enough to hold fifty thousand people.
(b) The movie was so long to watch in one sitting.
(c) I was shocked to hear that the shop had closed.
(d) There is nothing to be afraid.
(e) Strange to say, the cat opened the door by itself.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 형용사 + enough + to부정사예요. (b) 틀림: so 뒤에 to부정사는 쓸 수 없어요. too long to watch예요. (c) 옳음: 감정의 원인을 나타내는 to부정사예요. (d) 틀림: be afraid of 구조라서 nothing to be afraid of가 되어야 해요. (e) 옳음: 독립부정사 Strange to say예요. 따라서 정답은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The ice was thick (A) to hold the weight of the car.
(B) The ice was (B) thin to hold the weight of the car.
items.exp: (A)는 형용사 뒤에 enough가 오고, (B)는 '너무 ~해서 ...할 수 없다'는 too thin to hold예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? (×는 아무것도 쓰지 않음)
(A) The bag was too heavy for her to carry (A).
(B) The bag was so heavy that she couldn't carry (B).
items.exp: too ... to 구문에서는 주어가 to부정사의 목적어이므로 목적어를 다시 쓰지 않아요. so ... that절은 완전한 문장이라 it이 필요해요.

items.q:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> She was surprised [to see] her old friend at the airport.
choices: I have a lot of homework [to finish] today.
She went to the library [to borrow] some books.
He was glad [to receive] a letter from her.
[To learn] a new language is not easy.
He grew up [to be] a doctor.
items.exp: <보기>는 감정의 원인이에요. 정답이 같은 용법이고, 나머지는 각각 형용사적, 목적, 명사적(주어), 결과 용법이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> You must be brave [to speak] in front of so many people.
choices: The boy lived [to see] his hundredth birthday.
She studied hard [to become] a nurse.
This river is dangerous [to swim] in.
He must be rich [to own] such a big house.
items.exp: <보기>는 판단의 근거(~하다니)예요. 정답이 같고, 나머지는 감정의 원인, 결과, 목적, 형용사 수식이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 상자는 너무 무거워서 나 혼자서는 옮길 수 없었다.
items.s: The box was too heavy for me ___ alone.
items.exp: too ... for 목적격 to 동사원형 구문이에요. 의미상 주어 for me 뒤에 to carry를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 모든 사람을 도울 만큼 충분히 친절했다.
items.s: She was ___ everyone.
items.exp: 형용사 + enough + to부정사 순서예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The river was so wide that we couldn't swim across it.
items.s: The river was too wide ___ across.
items.exp: so ... that we couldn't ~ 는 too ... for 목적격 to ~로 바꿔요. 목적어 it은 생략해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The little girl grew up [be] a famous violinist. → ___
items.exp: '자라서 (결국) ~가 되다'는 결과의 to부정사 grew up to be를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She took a taxi [not to being] late for the interview. → ___
items.exp: 부정사의 부정은 not to + 동사원형이에요. being이 아니라 be를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 설상가상으로, 그 가게는 이미 문을 닫았다.
items.s: ___, the store had already closed.
items.exp: '설상가상으로'는 독립부정사 To make matters worse예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: She had her brother carry the heavy luggage upstairs.
The doctor advised him not to skip breakfast.
The manager had the employees to submit their reports by noon.
We heard a stranger shouting outside the window.
Mom allowed me to stay up late on Friday.
items.exp: 사역동사 have는 목적격보어로 원형부정사를 써요. to submit이 아니라 submit이 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: My sister got me to lend her my new jacket.
He asked me keep the secret.
She felt something to touch her shoulder.
Her advice helped me understanding the problem.
They expected the team win the final game.
items.exp: get이 '~하게 하다'의 뜻일 때는 사역동사와 달리 to부정사를 써요. ask와 expect는 to부정사, 지각동사 felt는 원형이나 -ing, help는 원형이나 to부정사를 써요.

items.q: 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
choices: It is important for teenagers to get enough sleep.
The exam was too difficult for most students to finish.
It was brave of the firefighter to enter the burning house.
I bought a large map for everyone to see.
It was very rude for him to ignore the elderly passenger.
items.exp: rude는 사람의 성품을 나타내는 형용사라서 의미상 주어를 of him으로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법에 맞는 문장은?
choices: It is dangerous of children to play near the river.
It was generous of them to donate so much money.
It was careless for him to leave the door open.
I want that you come early tomorrow.
It was smart for her to save the files twice.
items.exp: generous는 성품 형용사라 of them이 맞아요. dangerous는 성품이 아니라서 for를 쓰고, careless와 smart는 성품이라 of를 써야 해요. want는 that절이 아니라 want + 목적어 + to부정사예요.

items.q: 다음 중 문법적으로 올바른 문장을 고르세요.
choices: He got his friend help him move.
She wants that I attend the meeting.
It was wise for them to wait until morning.
The new app helps users find nearby cafes.
Please don't let the dog to go out.
items.exp: help는 목적격보어로 원형부정사와 to부정사를 모두 쓸 수 있어요. get은 to help, want는 목적어 + to attend, 성품 형용사 wise는 of them, let은 원형부정사가 필요해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The principal let the students leave early.
(b) I heard my name calling from behind.
(c) The cold weather made it difficult for us to go out.
(d) She told me not go outside after dark.
(e) The song helped me relaxing.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: let은 원형부정사를 목적격보어로 취해요. (b) 틀림: 이름은 '불리는' 대상이라 called가 되어야 해요. (c) 옳음: it은 가목적어, for us는 의미상 주어예요. (d) 틀림: tell의 목적격보어는 not to go예요. (e) 틀림: help 뒤에는 relax 또는 to relax가 와요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Dad didn't allow me use his laptop.
(b) It was foolish of me to trust the stranger.
(c) She felt her heart to beat faster.
(d) It is natural for children to ask many questions.
(e) The photo made me to remember my childhood.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: allow는 to use를 써야 해요. (b) 옳음: foolish는 성품 형용사라 of me가 맞아요. (c) 틀림: 지각동사 felt 뒤에는 beat 또는 beating이에요. (d) 옳음: natural은 성품 형용사가 아니라 for children이 맞아요. (e) 틀림: make는 원형부정사 remember를 써야 해요. 따라서 틀린 문장은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I'd like you to join our club.
(b) My father had my brother wash the car.
(c) It was thoughtful of her to send a card.
(d) The teacher told us not to make noise.
(e) We watched the children to play on the beach.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: want류 동사는 to부정사를 써요. (b) 옳음: 사역동사 have + 원형부정사예요. (c) 옳음: thoughtful은 성품 형용사라 of her예요. (d) 옳음: 부정은 not to + 동사원형이에요. (e) 틀림: 지각동사 watch 뒤에는 play 또는 playing이에요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Her teacher encouraged her to enter the speech contest.
(b) He got his little sister do his homework.
(c) I felt the ground shake beneath my feet.
(d) The film made us thinking about our future.
(e) It was silly of him to forget the password again.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: encourage + 목적어 + to부정사예요. (b) 틀림: get 뒤에는 to do를 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 지각동사 + 원형부정사예요. (d) 틀림: make 뒤에는 원형부정사 think를 써요. (e) 옳음: silly는 성품 형용사라 of him이 맞아요. 따라서 정답은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The guard didn't let anyone enter the building.
(b) It is impossible of him to finish the report today.
(c) My mother wanted me be a doctor.
(d) We saw a man climb the wall and jump over it.
(e) Heavy rain forced them to cancel the picnic.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: let + 목적어 + 원형부정사예요. (b) 틀림: impossible은 성품 형용사가 아니라 for him이 맞아요. (c) 틀림: want 뒤에는 to be가 와요. (d) 옳음: 지각동사 + 원형부정사가 이어져요. (e) 옳음: force + 목적어 + to부정사예요. 따라서 정답은 (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Her kindness helped him recover quickly.
(b) It was nice for you to lend me the book.
(c) The doctor ordered him resting for a week.
(d) I'm waiting for the bus arrive.
(e) It is essential for everyone to follow the safety rules.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: help 뒤에 원형부정사를 쓸 수 있어요. (b) 틀림: nice는 성품 형용사라 of you여야 해요. (c) 틀림: order + 목적어 + to rest가 되어야 해요. (d) 틀림: 의미상 주어 뒤에 to arrive가 와야 해요. (e) 옳음: essential은 성품이 아니라 for everyone이 맞아요. 따라서 정답은 (a), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The coach made the players (A) the field twice.
(B) The coach told the players (B) the field twice.
items.exp: make는 원형부정사 run을, tell은 to부정사 to run을 목적격보어로 취해요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) My boss made me (A) the report again.
(B) I was made (B) the report again by my boss.
items.exp: 능동태에서 make 뒤의 원형부정사는 수동태가 되면 to부정사로 바뀌어요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) It was thoughtful (A) him to hold the door for us.
(B) The lesson was too hard (B) the students to follow.
items.exp: thoughtful은 성품 형용사라 of him이고, hard는 성품 형용사가 아니라 for the students예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그녀가 문을 천천히 여는 것을 보았다.
items.s: I ___ the door slowly.
items.exp: 지각동사 saw 뒤에는 원형부정사 또는 현재분사를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 의사는 내게 하루에 물을 2리터 마시라고 충고했다.
items.s: The doctor ___ two liters of water a day.
items.exp: advise + 목적어 + to부정사 구조예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 노인을 도와주다니 그녀는 친절했다.
items.s: It was kind ___ the old man.
items.exp: kind는 성품 형용사라 의미상 주어가 of + 목적격이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My mother made me [to wash] the dishes. → ___
items.exp: 사역동사 made 뒤에는 원형부정사를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: It was rude [for] him to interrupt the speaker. → ___
items.exp: rude는 성품 형용사라 의미상 주어를 of him으로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 엄마는 내가 휴대전화를 너무 오래 사용하지 않기를 바라신다.
items.s: My mom ___ my phone too long.
items.exp: want + 목적어 + to부정사의 부정은 not to예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: She seems to have lost her keys on the way here.
The pictures appear to have been taken in the 1990s.
He pretended to be asleep when his mother came in.
The old man seems to be a famous singer when he was young.
I am glad to have met you at the party last night.
items.exp: when he was young은 주절(seems)보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 to have been이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He is too young to understand the rules.
The soup is too hot that I can't eat it.
The patient was lucky enough survive the accident.
The window seems to break by the storm last night.
items.exp: too ... that은 so ... that이 되어야 하고, 자전거는 수리되는 대상이라 to be repaired이며, enough 뒤에는 to survive가 와요. 창문은 폭풍에 '깨진' 것이고 과거 일이라 to have been broken이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
choices: I'm sorry to be late for today's meeting.
He is proud to have won the first prize last year.
I'm sorry to be late for yesterday's meeting.
The treasure is believed to have been hidden in a cave.
She hopes to be invited to the party next week.
items.exp: yesterday's는 주절의 시제(현재)보다 앞선 때이므로 to have been late이 되어야 해요. 나머지는 시점이 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 서로 다른 것은?
choices: The tea was too hot for me to drink. = The tea was so hot that I couldn't drink it.
The girl was too shy to speak. = The girl was so shy that she could speak.
He is rich enough to buy a yacht. = He is so rich that he can buy a yacht.
The bridge is strong enough to carry trucks. = The bridge is so strong that it can carry trucks.
The movie was too long for us to watch. = The movie was so long that we couldn't watch it.
items.exp: too ... to는 '너무 ~해서 ...할 수 없다'이므로 so ... that she couldn't speak으로 바꿔야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 같은 것은?
choices: It seems that he lost his wallet. = He seems to lose his wallet.
It seems that the boy is lonely. = The boy seems to have been lonely.
It seems that she is working late. = She seems to have worked late.
It seemed that he had left early. = He seemed to leave early.
It seems that the song was loved by everyone. = The song seems to have been loved by everyone.
items.exp: that절의 동사가 주절보다 앞선 시제이고 수동이므로 to have been p.p.로 바꿔요. 나머지는 시제가 맞지 않아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The jacket seems to have been made by hand.
(b) He seems to be sick yesterday, so he didn't come.
(c) I am happy to have been invited to your wedding.
(d) The cake was too sweet for me to finish.
(e) She was so tired to go out last night.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거에 만들어진 수동 관계라 to have been made가 맞아요. (b) 틀림: yesterday는 주절보다 앞선 때라 to have been이어야 해요. (c) 옳음: 초대받은 것이 앞선 일이라 완료 수동 부정사가 맞아요. (d) 옳음: too ... for 목적격 to 구문이에요. (e) 틀림: so tired that she couldn't 또는 too tired to go out이어야 해요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) He is believed to be living in Paris as a child.
(b) The printer needs to be fixed as soon as possible.
(c) The cat appears to have escaped through the window.
(d) The road was so narrow for two cars to pass.
(e) We are proud to have been chosen as the winners last year.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: as a child는 앞선 때라 to have lived가 되어야 해요. (b) 옳음: 프린터는 수리되는 대상이라 to be fixed가 맞아요. (c) 옳음: 완료부정사로 앞선 일을 나타내요. (d) 틀림: so 뒤에는 that절이 와야 해요. too narrow for two cars to pass가 맞아요. (e) 옳음: last year가 앞선 때를 나타내므로 완료 수동 부정사가 맞아요. 따라서 틀린 문장은 (a), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) She seems to enjoy the trip last weekend.
(b) The sofa is enough big to fill the room.
(c) The map seems to draw by a child.
(d) The soup was too salty that I couldn't eat it.
(e) She is said to have been a great dancer in her youth.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: last weekend는 앞선 때라 to have enjoyed가 되어야 해요. (b) 틀림: enough는 형용사 뒤에 와서 big enough가 되어야 해요. (c) 틀림: 지도는 그려진 것이므로 to have been drawn이어야 해요. (d) 틀림: too ... that은 쓰지 않고 so salty that을 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: in her youth는 앞선 때이므로 to have been이 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (e) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The story seems to have been written by a child.
(b) He is sorry to miss the meeting yesterday.
(c) The lecture was too boring for anyone to stay awake.
(d) The fence is enough high to keep the dogs out.
(e) The machine is said to have been invented in 1920.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 앞선 시제의 수동이라 to have been written이 맞아요. (b) 틀림: yesterday라서 to have missed가 되어야 해요. (c) 옳음: too ... for 목적격 to 구문이에요. (d) 틀림: high enough의 어순이에요. (e) 옳음: 과거에 발명된 수동이라 to have been invented가 맞아요. 따라서 정답은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) They seem to be waiting for you at the gate.
(b) The window appears to break by a ball.
(c) It was too dark for us to see anything.
(d) The wall was so high for him to climb.
(e) She wants to be remembered as a kind teacher.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 진행 중인 일이라 단순 부정사 진행형이 맞아요. (b) 틀림: 창문은 깨진 것이라 to have been broken이 되어야 해요. (c) 옳음: too ... for 목적격 to 구문이에요. (d) 틀림: too high for him to climb이어야 해요. (e) 옳음: 단순 수동 부정사가 맞아요. 따라서 정답은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This room needs cleaned before the guests arrive.
(b) The athlete seemed to have trained hard before the match.
(c) We were disappointed not to have been picked yesterday.
(d) The sofa is too heavy for one person to move.
(e) He was lucky enough to be rescued by the coast guard.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: needs to be cleaned 또는 needs cleaning이어야 해요. (b) 옳음: seemed보다 앞선 일이라 to have trained가 맞아요. (c) 옳음: 실망한 때보다 앞선 일이라 not to have been picked가 맞아요. (d) 옳음: too ... for 목적격 to 구문이에요. (e) 옳음: 형용사 + enough + to부정사 수동이에요. 따라서 정답은 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) She seems (A) a pianist when she was young.
(B) She seems (B) a pianist now.
choices: to have been – to have been
items.exp: (A)는 주절보다 앞선 때라 완료부정사, (B)는 now로 같은 때라 단순부정사예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The test was (A) easy that everyone finished it early.
(B) The test was (B) difficult for anyone to finish early.
items.exp: (A)는 that절과 쓰는 so, (B)는 to부정사와 쓰는 too예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The old castle seems (A) by a fire many years ago.
(B) The old castle needs (B) soon.
choices: to be destroyed – to be repaired
to have destroyed – to be repaired
to have been destroyed – to be repaired
to have been destroyed – to repair
items.exp: (A)는 앞선 때의 수동이라 to have been destroyed, (B)는 성은 수리되는 대상이라 to be repaired예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: It seems that she was ill last week.
items.s: She seems ___ ill last week.
items.exp: that절의 동사가 주절보다 앞선 시제이므로 완료부정사 to have been을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 소년은 너무 어려서 혼자 여행할 수 없다.
items.s: The boy is ___ alone.
items.exp: '너무 ~해서 ...할 수 없다'는 too + 형용사 + to부정사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 문제는 아주 쉬워서 모든 학생이 풀 수 있었다.
items.s: The problem was so easy that every student ___ it.
items.exp: so ... that 구문에서 '풀 수 있었다'는 could solve예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The photographs appear [to take] by a professional in the 1960s. → ___
items.exp: in the 1960s는 앞선 때이고 사진은 '찍힌' 것이라 to have been taken이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: He was [enough lucky] to win the lottery. → ___
items.exp: enough는 형용사 뒤에 놓아 lucky enough to win이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 어제 그 파티에 초대받아서 기뻤다.
items.s: I was happy ___ to the party yesterday.
items.exp: 어제 일이라 앞선 때이고 초대받은 것이라 완료 수동 부정사예요.

units.name: Ch5-1 동명사의 명사적 쓰임 · 의미상 주어 · 시제

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: My dream is becoming a pilot.
The boy is afraid of leaving alone at night.
She is proud of having won the contest last year.
Do you mind my opening the window?
I'm sorry for not calling you earlier.
items.exp: 소년은 '혼자 남겨지는' 대상이므로 수동 동명사 being left가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Being not honest will cost you your friends.
I'm proud of my father be a firefighter.
She denied to have taken the money.
He is ashamed of having been punished by the teacher.
Eat fresh vegetables every day is good for you.
items.exp: 앞선 때의 수동은 having been p.p.예요. 동명사의 부정은 Not being, 의미상 주어 뒤에는 being, deny는 동명사, 주어 자리는 Eating으로 써야 해요.

items.q: 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르세요.
choices: He complained about having treated unfairly at work.
I was surprised at her winning the first prize.
The audience was impressed by his singing so beautifully.
She was disappointed at not having been invited.
items.exp: 그가 '부당하게 대우받은' 것이므로 완료 수동 동명사 having been treated가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법에 맞는 문장은?
choices: Would you mind to open the window?
I'm tired of he complaining all the time.
She insisted on go there alone.
He is looking forward to meet you.
Do you mind my using your charger?
items.exp: 동명사의 의미상 주어는 소유격이나 목적격으로 써요. mind는 동명사를 목적어로 취하고, of와 on, to 같은 전치사 뒤에도 동명사가 와야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Writing a diary every night is a good habit.
(b) My hobby is collect old coins.
(c) I'm worried about his not passing the exam.
(d) She is proud of having be a volunteer last year.
(e) We were surprised at his winning the match.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 동명사가 주어예요. (b) 틀림: 보어 자리에는 동명사 collecting이 와야 해요. (c) 옳음: 의미상 주어 his, not은 동명사 앞에 있어요. (d) 틀림: 완료 동명사는 having been이에요. (e) 옳음: 의미상 주어로 소유격 his를 써요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Not eating breakfast can make you tired.
(b) Don't leave without say goodbye.
(c) He was proud of being praise by the principal.
(d) Your coming late again surprised no one.
(e) I'm afraid of not being understood by others.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부정은 동명사 앞에 not을 놓아요. (b) 틀림: 전치사 without 뒤에는 saying이 와요. (c) 틀림: 수동 동명사는 being praised예요. (d) 옳음: 소유격 의미상 주어가 있는 동명사 주어예요. (e) 옳음: not + being + p.p.의 부정 수동 동명사예요. 따라서 틀린 문장은 (b), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Never telling lies is the rule of our house.
(b) She is thinking about go abroad next year.
(c) He is sure of she telling the truth.
(d) I am worried about being not prepared.
(e) They were angry at having been fool by the salesman.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: never는 동명사 앞에 놓아요. (b) 틀림: 전치사 about 뒤에는 going이에요. (c) 틀림: 의미상 주어는 소유격 her나 목적격 her로 써요. (d) 틀림: 부정은 not being prepared 순서예요. (e) 틀림: 수동이라 having been fooled예요. 따라서 틀린 문장은 (b), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Staying up all night is bad for your health.
(b) I don't like my sister reading my diary.
(c) She is ashamed of having tell a lie.
(d) He kept silent without answer my question.
(e) I'm proud of having been selected as class president.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 동명사 주어예요. (b) 옳음: 명사 my sister가 동명사의 의미상 주어로 쓰였어요. (c) 틀림: 완료 동명사는 having told예요. (d) 틀림: without 뒤에는 answering이 와요. (e) 옳음: 완료 수동 동명사예요. 따라서 정답은 (a), (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Thank you for inviting me to your party.
(b) She is worried about not her son passing the exam.
(c) The boy was ashamed of being scolded in front of his friends.
(d) I am sure of he passing the test.
(e) Being praised by a teacher makes me happy.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 전치사 for 뒤 동명사예요. (b) 틀림: 의미상 주어 her son 뒤에 not을 써서 her son not passing이 되어야 해요. (c) 옳음: 수동 동명사예요. (d) 틀림: 의미상 주어는 소유격 his 또는 목적격 him이어야 해요. (e) 옳음: 수동 동명사 주어예요. 따라서 정답은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He denied having seen the thief.
(b) She is sure of lock the door before leaving.
(c) The prisoner complained of having been mistreated.
(d) They are proud of having be rewarded.
