(a) I wish I had taken a picture of the sunset yesterday.
(b) It's time that she took care of her health.
(c) The boys speak as if they are the managers of this shop, but they are only students.
(d) I wish I can swim like a dolphin.
(e) She felt as if she has been in a dream.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거 소망이라 I wish + had p.p.예요. (b) 옳음. it's time + that + 과거동사예요. (c) 틀림: 사실과 반대이므로 are가 아니라 were여야 해요. (d) 틀림: can이 아니라 could여야 해요. (e) 틀림: felt와 시점이 같거나 앞서는 가정이라 has been이 아니라 had been이어야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I wish I had studied more for the history test.
(b) It's time you will clean your room.
(c) The students talk as if they had met the author in person, but they haven't.
(d) I wish my uncle visits us more often.
(e) Mina wishes she had a twin sister now.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거 소망이므로 I wish + had p.p.예요. (b) 틀림: it's time 뒤에는 will이 아니라 과거동사 cleaned를 써요. (c) 옳음. as if + had p.p.예요. (d) 틀림: I wish 뒤에는 visited를 써야 해요. (e) 옳음. now가 있어 I wish + 과거동사 형태가 알맞아요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He acted as if nothing had happened.
(b) I wish I didn't forget his birthday yesterday.
(c) It's time we left for the airport.
(d) She wishes she could fly like a bird.
(e) I wish I would have been born in a warmer country.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. as if + had p.p.예요. (b) 틀림: yesterday(과거)이므로 hadn't forgotten이어야 해요. (c) 옳음. it's time + 과거동사예요. (d) 옳음. I wish + could + 동사원형이에요. (e) 틀림: wish 뒤에는 would have가 아니라 had been이 알맞아요. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It's time that the kids brushed their teeth.
(b) I wish we had a longer vacation this year.
(c) He looked as if he has been about to cry.
(d) She talks as if she had been born in London, but she was born in Seoul.
(e) I wish I would have told her the secret yesterday.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. it's time + that + 과거동사예요. (b) 옳음. I wish + 과거동사예요. (c) 틀림: has been이 아니라 were about to cry처럼 과거형이어야 해요. (d) 옳음. as if + had p.p.예요. (e) 틀림: would have told가 아니라 had told여야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
He talks as if he (A) everything about space, but in fact he (B) nothing about it.
items.exp: 현재의 사실과 반대로 말하므로 (A)는 as if + 과거동사 knew예요. (B)의 in fact는 실제 사실이라 현재시제 knows를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
I wish I (A) to the party yesterday. Look at the clock! It's time I (B) home now.
items.exp: yesterday의 일을 후회하므로 I wish + had gone, it's time 뒤에는 과거동사 went를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Look at the clock! It's time we (A). I wish we (B) here longer.
items.exp: it's time 뒤에는 과거동사 left를, I wish 뒤에는 could stay를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 지난주에 그에게 사실을 말했더라면 좋았을 텐데.
items.s: I wish I ___ last week.
items.exp: 과거에 이루지 못한 소망이므로 I wish + had p.p.를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 소년들은 마치 자기들이 영웅인 것처럼 행동한다.
items.s: The boys act as if they ___ heroes.
items.exp: 현재 사실과 반대로 행동하므로 as if 뒤에는 were를 써요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 같은 뜻의 가정법 문장으로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
items.s: I am sorry that my parents don't live near us. → I wish my parents ___ near us.
items.exp: 현재 사실의 반대를 소망하므로 I wish + 과거동사를 써요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 같은 뜻의 가정법 문장으로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
items.s: In fact, the girls didn't meet the actor. → The girls talk as if they ___ the actor.
items.exp: 말하는 시점보다 앞선 일을 반대로 가정하므로 as if + had p.p.를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: It's time you [to clean] your desk. → ___
a: It's time you cleaned your desk
items.exp: it's time 뒤에는 that절의 과거동사를 쓰므로 cleaned가 알맞아요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: He talks as if he [has met] the mayor yesterday. → ___
a: He talks as if he had met the mayor yesterday
items.exp: yesterday는 말하는 시점보다 앞선 과거이므로 as if + had p.p.를 써요.

units.name: Ch10-3 if 생략 · without, but for

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Had it not been for your advice, I would make a serious mistake.
Were the weather better, we would go on a picnic.
Had he not missed the train, he would have arrived on time.
Had the doctors arrived earlier, the patient would have survived.
Were I in your position, I wouldn't say yes.
items.exp: Had it not been for ~는 가정법 과거완료이므로 주절은 would have p.p.여야 해요. would make를 would have made로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Without the map, we could not found the hidden cave.
Had it not for the map, we could not have found the hidden cave.
Were it not for the map, we could not have found the hidden cave.
But the map, we could not have found the hidden cave.
But for the map, we could not have found the hidden cave.
items.exp: But for ~(~이 없었다면) 뒤에 could not have found가 와서 옳아요. 첫째는 could not found가 could not have found, 둘째는 Had it not for가 Had it not been for, 셋째는 과거 상황이라 Were가 아니라 Had it not been for, 넷째는 But이 아니라 But for여야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
(도치된 동사의 형태에 유의)
choices: Had we left earlier, we would have caught the bus.
Were the children quiet, I could finish my report.
Had Tom not helped me, I would not have passed the exam.
Had my cousins arrive on time, they would have seen the opening ceremony.
Had the players trained harder, they would have won the final.
items.exp: if가 생략된 가정법 과거완료는 Had + 주어 + p.p. 형태예요. arrive를 arrived로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
(if절을 대신하는 표현에 유의)
choices: I took a taxi; otherwise, I would have missed the first act.
I took a taxi; otherwise, I would miss the first act yesterday.
I took a taxi; without, I would have missed the first act.
I took a taxi; but for, I would have missed the first act.
I took a taxi; otherwise, I would had missed the first act.
items.exp: otherwise가 if절을 대신해 '택시를 타지 않았다면'의 뜻이고, 주절은 would have p.p.라서 옳아요. 나머지는 yesterday와 맞지 않는 would miss, without·but for 단독 사용(뒤에 명사 필요), would had missed가 틀려요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
(but for 뒤의 주절 시제에 유의)
choices: Without water, plants could not survive.
But for the teacher's help, I could not have solved the problem.
Were it not for the internet, our lives would be less convenient.
Had it not been for the storm, the ship would have reached the port.
But for the early warning, many people would be hurt during the storm last night.
items.exp: last night는 과거이므로 가정법 과거완료여야 해요. would be hurt를 would have been hurt로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Had I known about the test, I would have studied harder.
(b) Were I you, I would not to say that.
(c) Without sunlight, no plant can grow.
(d) Had it not been for his advice, I will have failed.
(e) Were it not for friends, my life would have been lonely.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. if를 생략한 가정법 과거완료예요. (b) 틀림: would not to say가 아니라 would not say여야 해요. (c) 옳음. Without은 전치사로 명사 sunlight 앞에 알맞게 쓰였어요. (d) 틀림: 주절은 will have failed가 아니라 would have failed여야 해요. (e) 틀림: Were it not for는 현재 상황이므로 would have been이 아니라 would be여야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Had the bus come on time, we would have reached the stadium before the game started.
(b) But for the lamp, we couldn't have found the key.
(c) Were the lake frozen, the children can skate on it.
(d) Were it not for the heavy traffic, we would have arrived earlier.
(e) Had I be more careful, I would not have made the mistake.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. if를 생략한 가정법 과거완료(Had + 주어 + p.p.)예요. (b) 옳음. But for + 명사, could not have p.p.예요. (c) 틀림: 가정법 과거의 주절은 can이 아니라 could skate여야 해요. (d) 틀림: 과거 상황이므로 Were가 아니라 Had it not been for여야 해요. (e) 틀림: Had I be가 아니라 Had I been이어야 해요. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Were my parents at home, they would be worried.
(b) Had the driver braked sooner, the accident might have been avoided.
(c) Without the lessons, I could not have passed the audition.
(d) Had it not been for her courage, nobody would have escaped.
(e) Were it not for the rain, we will have a picnic.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. if를 생략한 가정법 과거예요. (b) 옳음. if를 생략한 가정법 과거완료예요. (c) 옳음. Without + 명사, could not have p.p.예요. (d) 옳음. Had it not been for + 명사, would have p.p.예요. (e) 틀림: Were it not for 뒤의 주절은 will이 아니라 would have여야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Had we taken the shortcut, we would have reached the station sooner.
(b) Were I not so tired, I would go jogging with you.
(c) Without the map, the hikers would have been lost.
(d) But the doctor's help, he could not have recovered so quickly.
(e) Was the shop open, I would buy some bread.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. if를 생략한 가정법 과거완료예요. (b) 옳음. Were I not ~은 If I were not ~의 도치예요. (c) 옳음. Without + 명사, would have p.p.예요. (d) 틀림: But이 아니라 But for여야 해요. (e) 틀림: if 생략 도치에서는 was가 아니라 Were the shop open이어야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Had she known the answer, she would have raised her hand.
(b) Had the machine not stopped, the workers would have finished early.
(c) Were the roads not blocked, the ambulance would arrive in time.
(d) But for your encouragement, I would not tried again.
(e) Had been the weather better, we would have enjoyed the trip.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. if를 생략한 가정법 과거완료예요. (b) 옳음. Had + 주어 + not + p.p. 순서가 알맞아요. (c) 옳음. Were + 주어 + not ~의 가정법 과거예요. (d) 틀림: would not tried가 아니라 would not have tried여야 해요. (e) 틀림: 도치 어순은 Had the weather been better여야 해요. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Had the boys listen to the coach, they would have won.
(b) Were it not for the moonlight, the path would be too dark.
(c) Without his help, we are in trouble now.
(d) But for the delay, the train would have arrived at noon.
(e) Had it not been for the loud music, I would have slept well last night.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: Had the boys listened로 써야 해요. (b) 옳음. Were it not for + 명사, would 원형이에요. (c) 틀림: Without은 가정법과 쓰므로 are가 아니라 would be여야 해요. (d) 옳음. But for + 명사, would have p.p.예요. (e) 옳음. Had it not been for + 명사, would have p.p.예요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) the manager informed us earlier, we would have changed the plan.
(B) your support, I could not have finished this project.
items.exp: (A)는 if를 생략한 가정법 과거완료라서 Had가 와요. (B)는 '~이 없었다면'의 뜻으로 But for 뒤에 명사가 와요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) it not for your reminder, I would forget the meeting now.
(B) it not been for your reminder, I would have forgotten it.
items.exp: 현재 상황에는 Were it not for, 과거 상황에는 Had it not been for를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
I took the medicine; (A), I would have caught a cold. (B) his courage, the child could not have been saved.
items.exp: (A)는 if절을 대신하는 부사 otherwise가 알맞고, (B)는 '~이 없었다면'의 But for + 명사가 알맞아요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 그 사실을 알았더라면, 너에게 말해 줬을 텐데.
items.s: ___ the fact, I would have told you.
items.exp: if를 생략한 가정법 과거완료이므로 Had + 주어 + p.p. 순서로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 물이 없다면, 어떤 생명체도 살 수 없을 텐데.
items.s: ___ water, no living thing could survive.
items.exp: 현재 사실의 반대를 가정하는 If it were not for의 if가 생략되어 Were it not for가 돼요.

items.q: 다음 문장의 if를 생략하여 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
items.s: If it had not been for the fog, the flight would have left. → ___ not been for the fog, the flight would have left.
items.exp: if를 생략하면 had가 문장 맨 앞으로 나가 Had it not been for ~가 돼요.

items.q: 다음 문장의 if를 생략하여 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
items.s: If my brothers were here, they would fix the sink. → ___ here, they would fix the sink.
items.exp: if를 생략하면 were가 주어 앞으로 나가 Were my brothers here가 돼요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: [Had not] it been for the storm, we would have arrived earlier. → ___
a: Had it not been for the storm, we would have arrived earlier
items.exp: if를 생략한 도치 구문에서 부정어 not은 주어 뒤에 와서 Had it not been이 돼요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 엄마가 나를 깨웠다. 그렇지 않았다면 나는 학교에 지각했을 것이다.
items.s: Mom woke me up; otherwise, I ___ late for school.
items.exp: otherwise는 if절을 대신하므로 '깨우지 않았다면 지각했을 것'이라 would have p.p.를 써요.

units.name: Ch11-1 수의 일치 · 시제 일치와 예외

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Each of the rooms in the hotel has a balcony.
Everyone in the two classes was surprised at the result.
Mathematics and physics are my favorite subjects.
Ten kilometers is a long way to walk in this heat.
The key to the lockers in the gym were lost yesterday.
items.exp: 주어의 핵심은 단수 명사 The key이고 in the gym, to the lockers는 수식어구예요. were를 was로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: A number of cars was parked along the street.
Both the pilot and the co-pilot was ready for the flight.
The elderly in this town has little interest in the festival.
Whether he will come or not are not important to us.
To learn a new language takes time and effort.
items.exp: to부정사구 주어는 단수 취급하므로 takes가 알맞아요. 나머지는 was parked가 were parked, was가 were, has가 have, are not이 is not이어야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
(시제 일치의 예외에 유의)
choices: I read that water boiled at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
The teacher told us that the Earth goes around the Sun.
My grandmother said that she had lived in this town for fifty years.
We learned that the Korean War broke out in 1950.
He knew that honesty is the best policy.
items.exp: 과학적 사실은 주절이 과거여도 종속절에 현재시제를 써요. boiled를 boils로 고쳐야 해요. 나머지는 현재의 진리, 역사적 사실(과거), 속담(현재), 대과거로 모두 알맞아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
(주절의 시제에 유의)
choices: My father said that the Second World War ends in 1945.
The teacher said that the moon moved around the Earth.
I thought that he is a kind person.
She told me that she had lost her bag on the subway.
Mom said that practice made perfect.
items.exp: 주절이 과거이므로 종속절은 과거완료(had lost)로 써서 옳아요. 나머지는 역사적 사실이라 ended, 불변의 진리라 moves, 주절이 과거라 was, 속담이라 makes여야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
(수 일치에 유의)
choices: Every student in both classes has to wear a uniform.
Somebody in the audience is recording the performance.
The old are often wiser than the young.
Each of the players on both teams have a number on his back.
Economics has become more popular among high school students.
items.exp: each of ~는 단수 취급하므로 have를 has로 고쳐야 해요. 가까이 있는 복수 명사 teams에 속지 않아야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The United States has a long history of immigration.
(b) Many of the students says that the quiz was easy.
(c) Walking in the park every morning keeps me healthy.
(d) Our teacher said that the sun rose in the east.
(e) The young learn faster than the old.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 국가명은 복수형처럼 보여도 단수 취급해 has가 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: many of the students는 복수이므로 says가 아니라 say여야 해요. (c) 옳음. 동명사구 주어는 단수 취급해 keeps가 알맞아요. (d) 틀림: 불변의 진리이므로 rose가 아니라 rises여야 해요. (e) 옳음. the + 형용사는 복수 취급해 learn이 알맞아요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Each of the boys have his own locker.
(b) Two hundred meters are not a long distance for the runners.
(c) I learned that Columbus reached America in 1492.
(d) She said that she will call me the next day.
(e) A number of questions was asked after the lecture.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: each of ~는 단수라서 has여야 해요. (b) 틀림: 거리 단위는 단수 취급하므로 is여야 해요. (c) 옳음. 역사적 사실이므로 과거시제가 알맞아요. (d) 틀림: 주절이 과거이므로 will이 아니라 would여야 해요. (e) 틀림: a number of + 복수명사는 복수 취급해 were asked여야 해요. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The number of tourists visiting the island have doubled.
(b) Both my uncle and my aunt work at the hospital.
(c) Dad told me that the Titanic has sunk in 1912.
(d) Nobody in the neighborhood knows who stole the bike.
(e) My brother said that a stitch in time saved nine.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: the number of ~는 단수 취급하므로 has doubled여야 해요. (b) 옳음. both A and B는 복수 취급해 work가 알맞아요. (c) 틀림: 역사적 사실이므로 has sunk가 아니라 sank여야 해요. (d) 옳음. -body로 끝나는 부정대명사는 단수 취급해 knows가 알맞아요. (e) 틀림: 속담은 현재시제이므로 saved가 아니라 saves여야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Learning idioms is useful for improving your speaking.
(b) Physics are the subject that I like the most.
(c) She said that she was going to move to Jeju the following month.
(d) We learned that the Silk Road connected East and West in ancient times.
(e) That he lied to us are hard to forgive.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 동명사구 주어는 단수 취급해요. (b) 틀림: 학문명은 단수 취급하므로 is여야 해요. (c) 옳음. 주절이 과거이므로 종속절도 과거 시제로 알맞아요. (d) 옳음. 역사적 사실이라 과거시제가 알맞아요. (e) 틀림: that절 주어는 단수이므로 is여야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Fifty dollars is a lot of money for a student.
(b) The doctor told us that smoking is harmful to health.
(c) My teacher said that Newton discovered gravity.
(d) The wounded was carried to the hospital by helicopter.
(e) A lot of citizens are worried that the number of crows are increasing.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 금액 단위는 단수 취급해요. (b) 옳음. 일반적 사실이므로 현재시제가 알맞아요. (c) 옳음. 역사적 사실이라 과거시제가 알맞아요. (d) 틀림: the + 형용사는 복수 취급하므로 were여야 해요. (e) 틀림: the number of ~는 단수라서 is increasing이어야 해요. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Measles is a disease that spreads easily among children.
(b) The scientist said that sound travels faster in water than in air.
(c) Every one of the answers were correct.
(d) He told me that he will visit me the next week.
(e) Both of the twins plays the cello.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 질병명은 단수 취급해요. (b) 옳음. 과학적 사실이라 현재시제가 알맞아요. (c) 틀림: every one은 단수이므로 was여야 해요. (d) 틀림: 주절이 과거이므로 will이 아니라 would여야 해요. (e) 틀림: both는 복수이므로 play여야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (a), (b)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The number of cars on this road (A) rapidly, and a number of drivers (B) worried about it.
items.exp: the number of ~는 단수라서 is growing, a number of ~는 '많은'의 뜻으로 복수라서 are가 와요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
My teacher said that the Earth (A) around the Sun and that the Korean War (B) in 1950.
items.exp: 지구의 공전은 과학적 사실이라 현재시제 moves, 한국 전쟁은 역사적 사실이라 과거시제 broke out을 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Three miles (A) a long way to walk, but both of my brothers (B) used to it.
items.exp: 거리 단위는 단수 취급해 is, both of ~는 복수 취급해 are를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 도시를 방문하는 관광객의 수가 해마다 증가하고 있다.
items.s: The number of tourists visiting the city ___ every year.
items.exp: the number of ~는 단수 취급하므로 is를 써요. '증가하고 있다'는 현재진행형이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 많은 학생들이 도서관에서 시험 공부를 하고 있다.
items.hint: (study) 활용, a number of 사용, 현재진행형, 6단어
items.s: ___ for the exam in the library.
a: A number of students are studying
items.exp: a number of ~는 '많은'의 뜻으로 복수 취급하므로 are를 써요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
items.s: My teacher said to me, “World War II ended in 1945.” → My teacher told me that World War II ___ in 1945.
items.exp: 역사적 사실은 항상 과거시제를 써요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
items.s: He said, “I have lost my key.” → He said that he ___ his key.
items.exp: 주절이 과거일 때 종속절의 현재완료는 과거완료로 바뀌어요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: A number of passengers [was] waiting at the gate. → ___
a: A number of passengers were waiting at the gate
items.exp: a number of + 복수명사는 복수 취급하므로 were를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The teacher said that the Earth [was] round. → ___
a: The teacher said that the Earth is round
items.exp: 지구가 둥글다는 것은 불변의 진리라서 주절이 과거여도 현재시제를 써요.

items.q:
다음 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
Sam said to me, “I bought this bike two days ago.”
choices: Sam told me that he had bought that bike two days before.
Sam told me that he bought this bike two days ago.
Sam said me that he had bought that bike two days before.
Sam told me that I had bought that bike two days before.
Sam said to me that he had bought this bike two days before.
items.exp: said to는 told로 바꾸고, 시제는 과거완료, 지시어 this는 that, 부사 ago는 before로 바꿔요. 나머지는 시제·지시어·전달동사·인칭이 맞지 않아요.

items.q:
다음 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
Mom said to me, “Where did you put my glasses?”
(의문사가 있는 의문문)
choices: Mom asked me where did I put her glasses.
Mom asked me where I had put my glasses.
Mom asked me if I had put her glasses.
Mom said me where I had put her glasses.
Mom asked me where I had put her glasses.
items.exp: 의문사가 있는 의문문은 asked + 의문사 + 주어 + 동사의 평서문 어순이고, 과거는 과거완료로, my는 her로 바꿔요. 나머지는 도치 어순, 인칭 대명사, if 사용, said me가 틀려요.

items.q: 다음 중 직접화법을 간접화법으로 잘못 바꾼 것은?
choices: He said to her, “Are you ready?” → He asked her if she was ready.
She said to me, “Don’t touch the paint.” → She told me not to touch the paint.
Tom said to Amy, “I will call you tomorrow.” → Tom told Amy that he would call her the next day.
My sister said to me, “What are you doing now?” → My sister asked me what was I doing then.
The coach said to us, “Run faster.” → The coach ordered us to run faster.
items.exp: 의문사가 있는 의문문의 간접화법은 의문사 뒤에 주어 + 동사 순서가 되어야 해요. what was I doing을 what I was doing으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
Jane said to him, “Do you like my new haircut?”
(의문사가 없는 의문문)
choices: Jane asked him whether he liked her new haircut.
Jane asked him that he liked her new haircut.
Jane asked him if did he like her new haircut.
Jane asked him whether he likes my new haircut.
Jane asked him if he liked my new haircut.
items.exp: 의문사가 없는 의문문은 if나 whether를 쓰고 평서문 어순으로 바꿔요. 시제는 과거로, my는 her로 바꿔요.

items.q:
다음 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
The doctor said to me, “Don’t eat anything after nine.”
(부정명령문)
choices: The doctor advised me don't eat anything after nine.
The doctor advised me not eat anything after nine.
The doctor said me not to eat anything after nine.
The doctor advised not me to eat anything after nine.
The doctor advised me not to eat anything after nine.
items.exp: 부정명령문은 tell, advise 등 + 목적어 + not to부정사로 바꿔요. 나머지는 동사 형태, 어순, said me가 틀려요.

items.q:
다음 중 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것의 개수는?
(a) Ann said to me, “I am tired.” → Ann told me that she was tired.
(b) Bob said to me, “Do you know her?” → Bob asked me that I knew her.
(c) Mia said to Sam, “Where is my pen?” → Mia asked Sam where her pen was.
(d) Dad said to me, “Don’t run.” → Dad told me not to run.
(e) Joe said to her, “I’ll call you tomorrow.” → Joe told her that he will call her the next day.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 인칭과 시제를 알맞게 바꿨어요. (b) 틀림: 의문사 없는 의문문은 that이 아니라 if나 whether를 써야 해요. (c) 옳음. 의문사 뒤 평서문 어순과 시제·인칭이 알맞아요. (d) 옳음. 부정명령문은 not to부정사로 바꿔요. (e) 틀림: 시제를 일치시켜 will → would로 바꿔야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 직접화법을 간접화법으로 잘못 바꾼 것의 개수는?
(a) Kim said to me, “I am hungry.” → Kim told me that she was hungry.
(b) Lee said to us, “Be quiet.” → Lee told us to be quiet.
(c) Pam said to him, “Why are you late?” → Pam asked him why was he late.
(d) Dan said to her, “Do you like tea?” → Dan asked her if she liked tea.
(e) Mom said to me, “Don’t be late.” → Mom told me not be late.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 알맞아요. (b) 옳음. 명령문은 tell + 목적어 + to부정사예요. (c) 틀림: 간접의문문은 평서문 어순이므로 why he was late여야 해요. (d) 옳음. 알맞아요. (e) 틀림: not to be late가 되어야 해요. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것의 개수는?
(a) Eva said to me, “I met him today.” → Eva told me that she had met him that day.
(b) Ron said to me, “What do you need?” → Ron asked me what I needed.
(c) Kay said to us, “Come here.” → Kay told us to come there.
(d) Tim said to me, “I’m leaving now.” → Tim said me that he was leaving then.
(e) Jun said to her, “Can you swim?” → Jun asked her whether she could swim.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 시제와 부사가 알맞게 바뀌었어요. (b) 옳음. 알맞아요. (c) 옳음. here는 there로 바뀌어요. (d) 틀림: said me가 아니라 told me여야 해요. (e) 옳음. 알맞아요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Ken said to me, “I lost my key.” → Ken told me that he had lost his key.
(b) Nan said to him, “Don’t lie.” → Nan told him don’t lie.
(c) Ray said to me, “How old are you?” → Ray asked me how old I was.
(d) Una said to Tom, “Did you call me?” → Una asked Tom if he had called her.
(e) Dad said to us, “Be kind.” → Dad said us to be kind.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거는 과거완료로 바뀌어 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: not to lie로 바꿔야 해요. (c) 옳음. 알맞아요. (d) 옳음. 알맞아요. (e) 틀림: said us가 아니라 told us여야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 직접화법을 간접화법으로 잘못 바꾼 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Sue said to me, “I’m leaving now.” → Sue told me that she was leaving then.
(b) Hal said to us, “Where is the bank?” → Hal asked us where the bank was.
(c) Jim said to Ann, “Open the door.” → Jim told Ann to open the door.
(d) Mom said to me, “Where did you go?” → Mom asked me where had I gone.
(e) Lee said to her, “Don’t be late.” → Lee told her not being late.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 알맞아요. (b) 옳음. 알맞아요. (c) 옳음. 알맞아요. (d) 틀림: 간접의문문은 where I had gone 순서여야 해요. (e) 틀림: not to be late가 되어야 해요. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I said to Mina, “I’m proud of you.” → I told Mina that I was proud of her.
(b) Joy said to me, “Do you know my name?” → Joy asked me if I knew her name.
(c) Emma said to Jo, “I saw it a week ago.” → Emma told Jo that she had seen it a week ago.
(d) Roy said to us, “Don’t waste water.” → Roy told us not to waste water.
(e) Tom said to Kate, “Where did you buy these?” → Tom asked Kate where she had bought those.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 알맞아요. (b) 옳음. 알맞아요. (c) 틀림: ago는 before로 바꿔야 해요. (d) 옳음. 알맞아요. (e) 옳음. 의문사 뒤 평서문 어순이고 these는 those로 바꿨어요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Dad said to me, “Where did you leave your bike?”
→ Dad (A) me where I (B) my bike.
items.exp: 의문문의 전달동사는 asked, 간접의문문은 평서문 어순이고 과거는 과거완료로 바꿔요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
She said to him, “Don’t open the window.”
→ She (A) him (B) the window.
items.exp: said to는 told로 바꾸고, 부정명령문은 not to부정사로 바꿔요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Ben said to me, “I will visit you tomorrow.”
→ Ben (A) me that he (B) visit me (C).
items.exp: said to는 told, will은 would, tomorrow는 the next day로 바뀌어요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: Mina said to me, “I lost my wallet yesterday.” → Mina told me that ___.
a: she had lost her wallet the day before
she had lost her wallet the previous day
items.exp: 과거는 과거완료로, I는 she로, my는 her로, yesterday는 the day before 또는 the previous day로 바꿔요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: My father said to me, “What are you looking for now?” → My father asked me ___.
a: what I was looking for then
items.exp: 의문사 + 주어 + 동사 어순이고, are는 was, now는 then으로 바꿔요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: The clerk said to him, “Do you need a bag?” → The clerk asked him ___ a bag.
items.exp: 의문사가 없는 의문문은 if나 whether를 쓰고, 주어 + 동사 어순에 과거시제를 써요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: Mr. Park said to us, “Don’t leave your seats.” → Mr. Park told us ___ their seats.
items.exp: 부정명령문은 tell + 목적어 + not to부정사로 바꿔요. your는 their로 바뀌어 있어요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I asked her why [was she] angry. → ___
a: I asked her why she was angry
items.exp: 간접의문문은 의문사 뒤에 주어 + 동사 어순이므로 she was가 알맞아요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The teacher asked the students [that] they had finished the quiz. → ___
a: The teacher asked the students if they had finished the quiz
The teacher asked the students whether they had finished the quiz
items.exp: 의문사가 없는 의문문의 간접화법은 접속사 that이 아니라 if나 whether를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It was in the kitchen when my mother found the missing ring.
It was last Friday that the school festival began.
It was my uncle who taught me how to swim.
I did enjoy the movie, though many people didn't.
It is in this library that I met her for the first time.
items.exp: 장소 부사구를 강조하는 It was ~ that 구문에서는 that이나 where를 써요. when은 시간을 강조할 때 쓰므로 in the kitchen 뒤에는 that(where)이 와야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: She did made many mistakes in the test.
Tom do know the answer to the riddle.
It was at midnight what the phone rang.
None of the guests didn't enjoy the party.
He does want to join our team, but he is too shy to say so.
items.exp: 동사 강조는 do/does/did + 동사원형이라 does want가 알맞아요. 나머지는 did made가 did make, do가 does, what이 that(when), none과 not의 중복 사용이 틀려요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
(부정 표현과 수 일치에 유의)
choices: Not all the passengers were wearing seat belts.
Neither of the twins joined the club.
Not every question on the test was difficult.
Not every guest were satisfied with the service.
Good students don't always get the best grades.
items.exp: Not every 뒤에는 단수명사와 단수동사가 와요. were를 was로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
(강조 구문)
choices: It was last night that the thunder woke the baby.
It was at the mall who I met my old friend.
It was yesterday that did I buy this bag.
It is the pasta that Dad cooks it every Sunday.
It was Mina which broke the vase.
items.exp: 시간 부사구 last night를 강조한 It was ~ that 구문이라 옳아요. 나머지는 장소 강조에 who(that/where로 고침), that 뒤의 did I 도치, 불필요한 it, 사람에 which 사용이 틀려요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I do remember turning off the stove before leaving.
(b) It was at the station that I lost my wallet.
(c) She does speaks Chinese very well.
(d) It was Tom whom broke the window.
(e) Not all the books on this shelf is interesting.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. do + 동사원형으로 동사를 강조했어요. (b) 옳음. 장소 부사구 강조 구문이에요. (c) 틀림: does 뒤에는 동사원형 speak이 와야 해요. (d) 틀림: 주어를 강조할 때는 whom이 아니라 who나 that을 써요. (e) 틀림: Not all + 복수명사 뒤에는 복수동사 are가 와야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) It was the black cat that crossed the road.
(b) My parents did forgot my birthday.
(c) Neither of the two answers seemed right.
(d) It was in 2019 where the company moved to Busan.
(e) Not every dog like swimming.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 주어 강조 구문이에요. (b) 틀림: did 뒤에는 동사원형 forget이 와야 해요. (c) 옳음. neither는 둘에 대한 부정이에요. (d) 틀림: 시간 부사구를 강조할 때는 where가 아니라 that(when)을 써요. (e) 틀림: Not every + 단수명사 뒤에는 단수동사 likes가 와야 해요. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) He did apologize for being late.
(b) It is on Friday that the new film opens, not Saturday.
(c) Not all of the guests liked the soup.
(d) None of the students I asked knew the answer.
(e) It was the broken window who the police checked first.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. did + 동사원형이에요. (b) 옳음. 시간 부사구 강조 구문이에요. (c) 옳음. 부분부정이에요. (d) 옳음. 셋 이상 대상의 전체부정이에요. (e) 틀림: 사물 강조에는 who가 아니라 that(which)을 써요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I did tell you to bring your passport.
(b) It was in the park that we saw the fireworks.
(c) She did cried when she heard the news.
(d) It were my brother that cooked dinner.
(e) Not all the athletes are professionals.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. did + 동사원형이에요. (b) 옳음. 장소 강조 구문이에요. (c) 틀림: did cry여야 해요. (d) 틀림: It 뒤에는 was를 써서 It was my brother that이어야 해요. (e) 옳음. 부분부정이에요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Not every plan works as expected.
(b) None of the children I met didn't like candy.
(c) It was my aunt who sent me this package.
(d) He does enjoys playing chess with his grandfather.
(e) Neither of the two students passed the test.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 부분부정이에요. (b) 틀림: none과 not을 함께 쓸 수 없어요. didn't를 did로 고쳐야 해요. (c) 옳음. 주어 강조 구문이에요. (d) 틀림: does 뒤에는 동사원형 enjoy가 와야 해요. (e) 옳음. 둘에 대한 부정이에요. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It was during the summer vacation that I learned to swim.
(b) Nobody in the room didn't know the answer.
(c) Not all of the water in the lake is safe to drink.
(d) It was my homework what I forgot at home.
(e) Both of my cousins do arrived early.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 시간 강조 구문이에요. (b) 틀림: 부정어를 중복해 쓸 수 없어서 didn't를 did로 고쳐야 해요. (c) 옳음. 부분부정이에요. (d) 틀림: 목적어 강조에는 what이 아니라 that(which)을 써요. (e) 틀림: do 뒤에는 동사원형이 오고, 과거 강조는 did arrive여야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 that과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> It was in the park [that] I first met her.
choices: It is certain [that] he will win the game.
It seems [that] nobody noticed the mistake.
The movie [that] we saw last night was boring.
It was so cold [that] the lake froze.
It was my brother [that] broke the vase last night.
items.exp: <보기>는 'It was ~ that' 강조 구문의 that이에요. 정답도 my brother를 강조하는 that이에요. 나머지는 진주어절의 that, 관계대명사 that, so ~ that 구문의 that이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 did와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I [did] finish the homework before dinner.
choices: [Do] you know where the station is?
He [does] his homework in the library every day.
They [did] not agree with my idea.
She [does] want to join the club.
My father [does] the dishes after dinner.
items.exp: <보기>는 동사를 강조하는 조동사 did예요. 정답의 does도 want를 강조해요. 나머지는 의문문의 조동사, 부정문의 조동사, '하다'의 뜻인 본동사예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
My parents really (A) trust me these days, and it was my brother (B) broke the vase.
items.exp: these days가 있어 복수 주어 My parents에는 do를 쓰고, 주어를 강조하는 It was ~ 구문에서 사람은 who나 that을 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) of the two brothers liked swimming. (B) all the girls in the class could swim.
items.exp: 둘에 대한 부정은 neither, 부분부정 '모두 ~인 것은 아니다'는 Not all로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 어제 공원에서 만난 사람은 바로 너의 삼촌이었다.
items.s: ___ I met in the park yesterday.
items.exp: 목적어를 강조하는 It was ~ that 구문이에요. 사람이면 that 대신 who(m)도 쓸 수 있어요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 학생들이 모두 숙제를 끝낸 것은 아니었다.
items.hint: (finish) 활용, Not all 사용, students 사용
items.s: ___ their homework.
a: Not all of the students finished
items.exp: '모두 ~인 것은 아니다'는 Not all + 복수명사로 부분부정을 나타내요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 강조하는 문장이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
items.s: Mina found her lost cat in the garden. → It was ___ Mina found her lost cat.
items.exp: 장소 부사구 in the garden을 It was와 that 사이에 놓고 나머지를 뒤에 써요. that 대신 where도 가능해요.

items.q: 동사를 강조하는 문장이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
items.s: She likes the gift very much. → She ___ the gift very much.
items.exp: 주어가 3인칭 단수 현재이므로 does + 동사원형으로 강조해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: None of the students [didn't finish] the test. → ___
a: None of the students finished the test
items.exp: none은 이미 부정의 뜻이라 not과 함께 쓸 수 없어요. didn't finish를 finished로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: It was the red scarf [what] she lost on the bus. → ___
a: It was the red scarf that she lost on the bus
It was the red scarf which she lost on the bus
items.exp: 목적어를 강조하는 It was ~ that 구문에서 what은 쓸 수 없고 that이나 which를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Little they knew about the danger ahead.
On the roof sat a small bird.
Never have I seen such a huge dog.
Hardly did he notice the change.
Into the room ran the excited children.
items.exp: 부정어 little이 문장 앞에 오면 조동사가 주어 앞으로 나가는 도치가 일어나요. Little did they know about the danger ahead가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Beneath the tree lay she on the grass.
Seldom Mr. Kim visits his old friends.
I can't swim, and neither I can.
Not a single word he said to us.
Never did I imagine that I would win the prize.
items.exp: 부정어 Never가 앞에 오면 조동사 + 주어 + 동사원형 순서이라 옳아요. 나머지는 대명사 주어는 도치하지 않으므로 she lay, Seldom does Mr. Kim visit, neither can I, Not a single word did he say여야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
(so와 neither의 어순)
choices: My sister loves jazz, and so do I.
He didn't call me, and neither did she.
They have finished the project, and so have we.
She was late for class, and so I was.
I can't swim well, and neither can my brother.
items.exp: 앞 문장이 긍정이고 be동사 was이므로 '나도 그렇다'는 so was I로 써야 해요. so I was는 어순이 틀려요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
(동격 표현)
choices: She doubted the possibility of finishing the work in a day.
I was surprised at the news of that he had failed the test.
The fact of she was late made the teacher angry.
My teacher, a kind woman, she helped me a lot.
He had the idea what we should move to a new house.
items.exp: the possibility of + 동명사의 동격 표현이라 옳아요. 나머지는 news that, fact that, 동격 뒤에 중복된 주어 she 삭제, idea that으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Rarely do we eat out on weekdays.
(b) Little did the boy know about the surprise party.
(c) Never I have been so embarrassed.
(d) Under the sofa was it hiding.
(e) My brother can't ski, and neither I can.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 부정어 Rarely 뒤에 do we eat의 도치가 알맞아요. (b) 옳음. 부정어 Little 뒤에 조동사 did가 주어 앞에 와요. (c) 틀림: Never have I been으로 도치해야 해요. (d) 틀림: 주어가 대명사이면 도치하지 않으므로 Under the sofa it was hiding이에요. (e) 틀림: neither can I 어순이어야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) On the wall hung a portrait of the king.
(b) Seldom does she complain about her job.
(c) Never he has been late for school.
(d) Tom is a student, and so does Jane.
(e) The rumor of that the factory would close spread quickly.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 장소 부사구 + 동사 + 주어 도치예요. (b) 옳음. 부정어 Seldom 뒤에 does she가 알맞아요. (c) 틀림: Never has he been으로 도치해야 해요. (d) 틀림: 앞 문장이 be동사이므로 so is Jane이어야 해요. (e) 틀림: 동격절 앞에는 of that이 아니라 that만 써서 The rumor that ~이어야 해요. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Mr. Brown, our homeroom teacher, will visit us tomorrow.
(b) Not a word did the thief say to the police.
(c) Out of the box jumped a tiny kitten.
(d) I admire the idea that every child should have a library card.
(e) At no time we were allowed to leave the room.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 콤마로 연결한 명사 동격이에요. (b) 옳음. 부정어구 Not a word 뒤에 did the thief say가 알맞아요. (c) 옳음. 방향 부사구 + 동사 + 주어 도치예요. (d) 옳음. the idea that ~ 동격절이에요. (e) 틀림: 부정어구 At no time 뒤는 were we allowed로 도치해야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Away flew the red balloon.
(b) Hardly he noticed the strange smell.
(c) She never lies, and neither does her brother.
(d) The news that the museum was closed disappointed us.
(e) The promise of that he would come back made me happy.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 방향 부사 + 동사 + 주어 도치예요. (b) 틀림: Hardly did he notice로 도치해야 해요. (c) 옳음. 부정문 뒤 neither + 조동사 + 주어예요. (d) 옳음. the news that ~ 동격절이에요. (e) 틀림: of that이 아니라 The promise that ~이어야 해요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Little did they realize the danger.
(b) Over the fence climbed the boys.
(c) Beyond the mountains lies a beautiful valley.
(d) My friends love comics, and so I do.
(e) Mr. Han, a famous pianist, he gave a concert.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 부정어 도치가 알맞아요. (b) 옳음. 방향 부사구 + 동사 + 주어예요. (c) 옳음. 장소 부사구 + 동사 + 주어예요. (d) 틀림: so do I 어순이어야 해요. (e) 틀림: 동격 뒤에 주어 he가 중복되어 he를 삭제해야 해요. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) In the corner of the room sat an old man.
(b) Nowhere I could find my keys.
(c) Seldom they go to the movies.
(d) He is a fan of this team, and neither am I.
(e) She made the decision to quit the job.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 장소 부사구 + 동사 + 주어 도치예요. (b) 틀림: Nowhere could I find로 도치해야 해요. (c) 틀림: Seldom do they go로 도치해야 해요. (d) 틀림: 앞 문장이 긍정이므로 so am I여야 해요. (e) 옳음. the decision to + 동사원형 동격 표현이에요. 따라서 어법상 옳은 것은 (a), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Seldom (A) she complain about her salary these days. She can't drive, and (B) I.
items.exp: these days는 현재라서 Seldom does she complain이 알맞아요. 부정문 뒤에는 neither + 조동사 can + 주어를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The news (A) our team had won the final made us happy. He gave up the idea (B) moving to Canada.
items.exp: the news 뒤에는 동격의 that절이, the idea 뒤에는 of + 동명사가 와요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 that과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I agreed with the idea [that] the rule should be changed.
choices: We heard the rumor [that] the school would close next year.
The book [that] I borrowed was very old.
It is true [that] she passed the exam.
He said [that] he would come soon.
items.exp: <보기>는 the idea 뒤에서 내용을 설명하는 동격의 that이에요. 정답도 the rumor의 내용을 설명해요. 나머지는 관계대명사, 진주어절, 감정 원인, 목적어절의 that이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 so와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I like pizza, and [so] does my brother.
choices: She was [so] tired that she fell asleep.
He is not [so] tall as his father.
Mia can ski, and [so] can I.
items.exp: <보기>는 긍정문 뒤에서 '~도 역시 그렇다'를 뜻하는 so + 조동사 + 주어예요. 정답도 같은 쓰임이에요. 나머지는 so ~ that, 원급 비교, 대용어로 쓰인 so예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나무 아래에 늙은 개 한 마리가 누워 있었다.
items.s: Under the tree ___.
items.exp: 장소 부사구가 앞에 오면 동사 + 주어 순서로 도치해요. 과거의 lie는 lay예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 그렇게 아름다운 풍경을 본 적이 없었다.
items.s: Never ___ such beautiful scenery.
items.exp: 부정어 Never가 앞에 오면 조동사가 주어 앞으로 나가요. 과거 이전의 경험이라 had he seen이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그 소식에 놀라지 않았고, 내 형도 그랬다.
items.s: I wasn't surprised at the news, and ___.
items.exp: 부정문 뒤에서 '~도 그렇지 않다'는 neither + be동사 + 주어로 써요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 부정어로 시작하는 문장으로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
items.s: She seldom eats breakfast. → Seldom ___ breakfast.
items.exp: 부정어를 앞으로 보내면 do 동사가 주어 앞으로 가고 본동사는 원형이 돼요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Little [I knew] about his plan. → ___
a: Little did I know about his plan
items.exp: 부정어 Little이 앞에 오면 조동사 + 주어 + 동사원형 순서이므로 did I know가 알맞아요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The rumor [what] he had quit the job spread fast. → ___
a: The rumor that he had quit the job spread fast
items.exp: the rumor의 내용을 설명하는 동격절은 접속사 that으로 이끌어요.
